1.zh: 以下所记的是摩西在约旦河东的旷野、疏弗对面的亚拉巴—就是巴兰、陀弗、拉班、哈洗录、底撒哈中间—向以色列众人所说的话。（
1.en: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

1.zh: 从何烈山经过西珥山到加低斯·巴尼亚有十一天的[路程]。）
1.en: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

1.zh: 出埃及第四十年十一月初一日，摩西照耶和华借着他所吩咐以色列人的话都晓谕他们。
1.en: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the LORD had given him in commandment to them,

1.zh: 那时，他已经击杀了住希实本的亚摩利王西宏和住以得来、亚斯他录的巴珊王噩。
1.en: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.

1.zh: 摩西在约旦河东的摩押地讲律法说：
1.en: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

1.zh: 「耶和华—我们的　神在何烈山晓谕我们说：你们在这山上住的日子够了；
1.en: “The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.

1.zh: 要起行转到亚摩利人的山地和靠近这山地的各处，就是亚拉巴、山地、高原、南地，沿海一带迦南人的地，并黎巴嫩山又到幼发拉底大河。
1.en: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

1.zh: 如今我将这地摆在你们面前；你们要进去得这地，就是耶和华向你们列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许赐给他们和他们后裔为业之地。」
1.en: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”

1.zh: 「那时，我对你们说：『管理你们的重任，我独自担当不起。
1.en: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.

1.zh: 耶和华—你们的　神使你们多起来。看哪，你们今日像天上的星那样多。
1.en: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.

1.zh: 惟愿耶和华—你们列祖的　神使你们比如今更多千倍，照他所应许你们的话赐福与你们。
1.en: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!

1.zh: 但你们的麻烦，和管理你们的重任，并你们的争讼，我独自一人怎能担当得起呢？
1.en: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?

1.zh: 你们要按着各支派选举有智慧、有见识、为众人所认识的，我立他们为你们的首领。』
1.en: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”

1.zh: 你们回答我说：『照你所说的行了为妙。』
1.en: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”

1.zh: 我便将你们各支派的首领，有智慧、为众人所认识的，照你们的支派，立他们为官长、千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十夫长，管理你们。
1.en: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

1.zh: 「当时，我嘱咐你们的审判官说：『你们听讼，无论是弟兄彼此争讼，是与同居的外人争讼，都要按公义判断。
1.en: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.

1.zh: 审判的时候，不可看人的外貌；听讼不可分贵贱，不可惧怕人，因为审判是属乎　神的。若有难断的案件，可以呈到我这里，我就判断。』
1.en: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”

1.zh: 那时，我将你们所当行的事都吩咐你们了。」
1.en: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

1.zh: 「我们照着耶和华—我们　神所吩咐的从何烈山起行，经过你们所看见那大而可怕的旷野，往亚摩利人的山地去，到了加低斯·巴尼亚。
1.en: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.

1.zh: 我对你们说：『你们已经到了耶和华—我们　神所赐给我们的亚摩利人之山地。
1.en: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God gives to us.

1.zh: 看哪，耶和华—你的　神已将那地摆在你面前，你要照耶和华—你列祖的　神所说的上去得那地为业；不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。』
1.en: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as the LORD the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”

1.zh: 你们都就近我来说：『我们要先打发人去，为我们窥探那地，将我们上去该走何道，必进何城，都回报我们。』
1.en: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”

1.zh: 这话我以为美，就从你们中间选了十二个人，每支派一人。
1.en: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.

1.zh: 于是他们起身上山地去，到以实各谷，窥探那地。
1.en: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

1.zh: 他们手里拿着那地的果子下来，到我们那里，回报说：『耶和华—我们的　神所赐给我们的是美地。』
1.en: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which the LORD our God gives to us.”

1.zh: 「你们却不肯上去，竟违背了耶和华—你们　神的命令，
1.en: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God.

1.zh: 在帐棚内发怨言说：『耶和华因为恨我们，所以将我们从埃及地领出来，要交在亚摩利人手中，除灭我们。
1.en: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because the LORD hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.

1.zh: 我们上哪里去呢？我们的弟兄使我们的心消化，说那[地的]民比我们又大又高，城邑又广大又坚固，高得顶天，并且我们在那里看见亚衲族的人。』
1.en: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”

1.zh: 我就对你们说：『不要惊恐，也不要怕他们。
1.en: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.

1.zh: 在你们前面行的耶和华—你们的　神必为你们争战，正如他在埃及和旷野，在你们眼前所行的一样。
1.en: The LORD your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

1.zh: 你们在旷野所行的路上，也曾见耶和华—你们的　神抚养你们，如同人抚养儿子一般，直等你们来到这地方。』
1.en: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”

1.zh: 你们在这事上却不信耶和华—你们的　神。
1.en: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe the LORD your God,

1.zh: 他在路上，在你们前面行，为你们找安营的地方；夜间在火[柱]里，日间在云[柱]里，指示你们所当行的路。」
1.en: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.

1.zh: 「耶和华听见你们这话，就发怒，起誓说：
1.en: The LORD heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,

1.zh: 『这恶世代的人，连一个也不得见我起誓应许赐给你们列祖的美地；
1.en: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,

1.zh: 惟有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒必得看见，并且我要将他所踏过的地赐给他和他的子孙，因为他专心跟从我。』
1.en: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed the LORD.”

1.zh: 耶和华为你的缘故也向我发怒，说：『你必不得进入那地。
1.en: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.

1.zh: 伺候你、嫩的儿子约书亚，他必得进入那地；你要勉励他，因为他要使以色列人承受那地为业。
1.en: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

1.zh: 并且你们的[妇人]孩子，就是你们所说、必被掳掠的，和今日不知善恶的儿女，必进入那地。我要将那地赐给他们，他们必得为业。
1.en: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

1.zh: 至于你们，要转回，从红海的路往旷野去。』
1.en: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

1.zh: 「那时，你们回答我说：『我们得罪了耶和华，情愿照耶和华—我们　神一切所吩咐的上去争战。』于是你们各人带着兵器，争先上山地去了。
1.en: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against the LORD. We will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.

1.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：『你对他们说：不要上去，也不要争战；因我不在你们中间，恐怕你们被仇敌杀败了。』
1.en: The LORD said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”

1.zh: 我就告诉了你们，你们却不听从，竟违背耶和华的命令，擅自上山地去了。
1.en: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.

1.zh: 住那山地的亚摩利人就出来攻击你们，追赶你们，如蜂拥一般，在西珥杀退你们，直到何珥玛。
1.en: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.

1.zh: 你们便回来，在耶和华面前哭号；耶和华却不听你们的声音，也不向你们侧耳。
1.en: You returned and wept before the LORD, but the LORD didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.

1.zh: 于是你们在加低斯住了许多日子。」
1.en: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

2.zh: 「此后，我们转回，从红海的路往旷野去，是照耶和华所吩咐我的。我们在西珥山绕行了许多日子。
2.en: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.

2.zh: 耶和华对我说：
2.en: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

2.zh: 『你们绕行这山的日子够了，要转向北去。
2.en: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

2.zh: 你吩咐百姓说：你们弟兄以扫的子孙住在西珥，你们要经过他们的境界。他们必惧怕你们，所以你们要分外谨慎。
2.en: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.

2.zh: 不可与他们争战；他们的地，连脚掌可踏之处，我都不给你们，因我已将西珥山赐给以扫为业。
2.en: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.

2.zh: 你们要用钱向他们买粮吃，也要用钱向他们买水喝。
2.en: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”

2.zh: 因为耶和华—你的　神在你手里所办的一切事上已赐福与你。你走这大旷野，他都知道了。这四十年，耶和华—你的　神常与你同在，故此你一无所缺。』
2.en: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, the LORD your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.

2.zh: 「于是，我们离了我们弟兄以扫子孙所住的西珥，从亚拉巴的路，经过以拉他、以旬·迦别，转向摩押旷野的路去。
2.en: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

2.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：『不可扰害摩押人，也不可与他们争战。他们的地，我不赐给你为业，因我已将亚珥赐给罗得的子孙为业。』
2.en: The LORD said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”

2.zh: 先前，有以米人住在那里，民数众多，身体高大，像亚衲人一样。
2.en: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.

2.zh: 这以米人像亚衲人；也算为利乏音人；摩押人称他们为以米人。
2.en: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

2.zh: 先前，何利人也住在西珥，但以扫的子孙将他们除灭，得了他们的地，接着居住，就如以色列在耶和华赐给他为业之地所行的一样。
2.en: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which the LORD gave to them.)

2.zh: 现在，起来过撒烈溪！于是我们过了撒烈溪。
2.en: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.

2.zh: 自从离开加低斯·巴尼亚，到过了撒烈溪的时候，共有三十八年，等那世代的兵丁都从营中灭尽，正如耶和华向他们所起的誓。
2.en: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as the LORD swore to them.

2.zh: 耶和华的手也攻击他们，将他们从营中除灭，直到灭尽。
2.en: Moreover the LORD’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.

2.zh: 「兵丁从民中都灭尽死亡以后，
2.en: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

2.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：
2.en: the LORD spoke to me, saying,

2.zh: 『你今天要从摩押的境界亚珥经过，
2.en: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.

2.zh: 走近亚扪人之地，不可扰害他们，也不可与他们争战。亚扪人的地，我不赐给你们为业，因我已将那地赐给罗得的子孙为业。』
2.en: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”

2.zh: 那地也算为利乏音人之地，先前利乏音人住在那里，亚扪人称他们为散送冥。
2.en: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

2.zh: 那民众多，身体高大，像亚衲人一样，但耶和华从亚扪人面前除灭他们，亚扪人就得了他们的地，接着居住。
2.en: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but the LORD destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,

2.zh: 正如耶和华从前为住西珥的以扫子孙将何利人从他们面前除灭、他们得了何利人的地、接着居住一样，直到今日。
2.en: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.

2.zh: 从迦斐托出来的迦斐托人将先前住在乡村直到迦萨的亚卫人除灭，接着居住。
2.en: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)

2.zh: 你们起来前往，过亚嫩谷；我已将亚摩利人希实本王西宏和他的地交在你手中，你要与他争战，得他的地为业。
2.en: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

2.zh: 从今日起，我要使天下万民听见你的名声都惊恐惧怕，且因你发颤伤恸。」
2.en: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”

2.zh: 「我从基底莫的旷野差遣使者去见希实本王西宏，用和睦的话说：
2.en: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

2.zh: 『求你容我从你的地经过，只走大道，不偏左右。
2.en: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.

2.zh: 你可以卖粮给我吃，也可以卖水给我喝，只要容我步行过去，
2.en: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,

2.zh: 就如住西珥的以扫子孙和住亚珥的摩押人待我一样，等我过了约旦河，好进入耶和华—我们　神所赐给我们的地。』
2.en: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which the LORD our God gives us.”

2.zh: 但希实本王西宏不容我们从他那里经过；因为耶和华—你的　神使他心中刚硬，性情顽梗，为要将他交在你手中，像今日一样。
2.en: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.

2.zh: 耶和华对我说：『从此起首，我要将西宏和他的地交给你；你要得他的地为业。』
2.en: The LORD said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”

2.zh: 那时，西宏和他的众民出来攻击我们，在雅杂与我们交战。
2.en: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.

2.zh: 耶和华—我们的　神将他交给我们，我们就把他和他的儿子，并他的众民，都击杀了。
2.en: The LORD our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.

2.zh: 我们夺了他的一切城邑，将有人烟的各城，连女人带孩子，尽都毁灭，没有留下一个。
2.en: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.

2.zh: 惟有牲畜和所夺的各城，并其中的财物，都取为自己的掠物。
2.en: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.

2.zh: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，直到基列，耶和华—我们的　神都交给我们了，没有一座城高得使我们不能攻取的。
2.en: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. The LORD our God delivered up all before us.

2.zh: 惟有亚扪人之地，凡靠近雅博河的地，并山地的城邑，与耶和华—我们　神所禁止我们去的地方，都没有挨近。」
2.en: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever the LORD our God forbade us.

3.zh: 「以后，我们转回，向巴珊去。巴珊王噩和他的众民都出来，在以得来与我们交战。
3.en: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

3.zh: 耶和华对我说：『不要怕他！因我已将他和他的众民，并他的地，都交在你手中；你要待他像从前待住希实本的亚摩利王西宏一样。』
3.en: The LORD said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

3.zh: 于是耶和华—我们的　神也将巴珊王噩和他的众民都交在我们手中；我们杀了他们，没有留下一个。
3.en: So the LORD our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.

3.zh: 那时，我们夺了他所有的城，共有六十座，没有一座城不被我们所夺。这为亚珥歌伯的全境，就是巴珊地噩王的国。
3.en: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

3.zh: 这些城都有坚固的高墙，有门有闩。此外还有许多无城墙的乡村。
3.en: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

3.zh: 我们将这些都毁灭了，像从前待希实本王西宏一样，把有人烟的各城，连女人带孩子，尽都毁灭；
3.en: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.

3.zh: 惟有一切牲畜和城中的财物都取为自己的掠物。
3.en: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.

3.zh: 那时，我们从约旦河东两个亚摩利王的手将亚嫩谷直到黑门山之地夺过来（
3.en: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

3.zh: 这黑门山，西顿人称为西连，亚摩利人称为示尼珥），
3.en: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)

3.zh: 就是夺了平原的各城、基列全地、巴珊全地，直到撒迦和以得来，都是巴珊王噩国内的城邑。（
3.en: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

3.zh: 利乏音人所剩下的只有巴珊王噩。他的床是铁的，长九肘，宽四肘，都是以人肘为度。现今岂不是在亚扪人的拉巴吗？）」
3.en: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)

3.zh: 「那时，我们得了这地。从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥起，我将基列山地的一半，并其中的城邑，都给了吕便人和迦得人。
3.en: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

3.zh: 其余的基列地和巴珊全地，就是噩王的国，我给了玛拿西半支派。亚珥歌伯全地乃是巴珊全地；这叫做利乏音人之地。
3.en: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

3.zh: 玛拿西的子孙睚珥占了亚珥歌伯全境，直到基述人和玛迦人的交界，就按自己的名称这巴珊地为哈倭特·睚珥，直到今日。
3.en: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)

3.zh: 我又将基列给了玛吉。
3.en: I gave Gilead to Machir.

3.zh: 从基列到亚嫩谷，以谷中为界，直到亚扪人交界的雅博河，我给了吕便人和迦得人，
3.en: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

3.zh: 又将亚拉巴和靠近约旦河之地，从基尼烈直到亚拉巴海，就是盐海，并毗斯迦山根东边之地，[都给了他们]。
3.en: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

3.zh: 「那时，我吩咐你们说：『耶和华—你们的　神已将这地赐给你们为业；你们所有的勇士都要带着兵器，在你们的弟兄以色列人前面过去。
3.en: I commanded you at that time, saying, “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.

3.zh: 但你们的妻子、孩子、牲畜（我知道你们有许多的牲畜）可以住在我所赐给你们的各城里。
3.en: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,

3.zh: 等到你们弟兄在约旦河那边，也得耶和华—你们　神所赐给他们的地，又使他们得享平安，与你们一样，你们才可以回到我所赐给你们为业之地。』
3.en: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”

3.zh: 那时我吩咐约书亚说：『你亲眼看见了耶和华—你　神向这二王所行的；耶和华也必向你所要去的各国照样行。
3.en: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over.

3.zh: 你不要怕他们，因那为你争战的是耶和华—你的　神。』」
3.en: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.”

3.zh: 「那时，我恳求耶和华说：
3.en: I begged GOD at that time, saying,

3.zh: 『主耶和华啊，你已将你的大力大能显给仆人看。在天上，在地下，有什么神能像你行事、像你有大能的作为呢？
3.en: “Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?

3.zh: 求你容我过去，看约旦河那边的美地，就是那佳美的山地和黎巴嫩。』
3.en: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”

3.zh: 但耶和华因你们的缘故向我发怒，不应允我，对我说：『罢了！你不要向我再提这事。
3.en: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. The LORD said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.

3.zh: 你且上毗斯迦山顶去，向东、西、南、北举目观望，因为你必不能过这约旦河。
3.en: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.

3.zh: 你却要嘱咐约书亚，勉励他，使他胆壮；因为他必在这百姓前面过去，使他们承受你所要观看之地。』
3.en: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”

3.zh: 于是我们住在伯·毗珥对面的谷中。」
3.en: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

4.zh: 「以色列人哪，现在我所教训你们的律例典章，你们要听从遵行，好叫你们存活，得以进入耶和华—你们列祖之　神所赐给你们的地，承受为业。
4.en: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, gives you.

4.zh: 所吩咐你们的话，你们不可加添，也不可删减，好叫你们遵守我所吩咐的，就是耶和华—你们　神的命令。
4.en: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

4.zh: 耶和华因巴力·毗珥的事所行的，你们亲眼看见了。凡随从巴力·毗珥的人，耶和华—你们的　神都从你们中间除灭了。
4.en: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.

4.zh: 惟有你们专靠耶和华—你们　神的人，今日全都存活。
4.en: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today.

4.zh: 我照着耶和华—我　神所吩咐的将律例典章教训你们，使你们在所要进去得为业的地上遵行。
4.en: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

4.zh: 所以你们要谨守遵行；这就是你们在万民眼前的智慧、聪明。他们听见这一切律例，必说：『这大国的人真是有智慧，有聪明！』
4.en: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

4.zh: 哪一大国的人有神与他们相近，像耶和华—我们的　神、在我们求告他的时候与我们相近呢？
4.en: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him?

4.zh: 又哪一大国有这样公义的律例典章、像我今日在你们面前所陈明的这一切律法呢？
4.en: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

4.zh: 「你只要谨慎，殷勤保守你的心灵，免得忘记你亲眼所看见的事，又免得你一生、这事离开你的心；总要传给你的子子孙孙。
4.en: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—

4.zh: 你在何烈山站在耶和华—你　神面前的那日，耶和华对我说：『你为我招聚百姓，我要叫他们听见我的话，使他们存活在世的日子，可以学习敬畏我，又可以教训儿女这样行。』
4.en: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”

4.zh: 那时你们近前来，站在山下；山上有火焰冲天，并有昏黑、密云、幽暗。
4.en: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

4.zh: 耶和华从火焰中对你们说话，你们只听见声音，却没有看见形象。
4.en: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.

4.zh: 他将所吩咐你们当守的约指示你们，就是十条诫，并将这诫写在两块石版上。
4.en: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.

4.zh: 那时耶和华又吩咐我将律例典章教训你们，使你们在所要过去得为业的地上遵行。」
4.en: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

4.zh: 「所以，你们要分外谨慎；因为耶和华在何烈山、从火中对你们说话的那日，你们没有看见什么形象。
4.en: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,

4.zh: 惟恐你们败坏自己，雕刻偶像，仿佛什么男像女像，
4.en: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

4.zh: 或地上走兽的像，或空中飞鸟的像，
4.en: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,

4.zh: 或地上爬物的像，或地底下水中鱼的像。
4.en: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

4.zh: 又恐怕你向天举目观看，见耶和华—你的　神为天下万民所摆列的日月星，就是天上的万象，自己便被勾引敬拜事奉它。
4.en: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.

4.zh: 耶和华将你们从埃及领出来，脱离铁炉，要特作自己产业的子民，像今日一样。
4.en: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.

4.zh: 耶和华又因你们的缘故向我发怒，起誓必不容我过约旦河，也不容我进入耶和华—你　神所赐你为业的那美地。
4.en: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance;

4.zh: 我只得死在这地，不能过约旦河；但你们必过去得那美地。
4.en: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.

4.zh: 你们要谨慎，免得忘记耶和华—你们　神与你们所立的约，为自己雕刻偶像，就是耶和华—你　神所禁止你做的偶像；
4.en: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.

4.zh: 因为耶和华—你的　神乃是烈火，是忌邪的　神。
4.en: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

4.zh: 「你们在那地住久了，生子生孙，就雕刻偶像，仿佛什么形象，败坏自己，行耶和华—你　神眼中看为恶的事，惹他发怒。
4.en: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,

4.zh: 我今日呼天唤地向你们作见证，你们必在过约旦河得为业的地上速速灭尽！你们不能在那地上长久，必尽行除灭。
4.en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.

4.zh: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中；在他所领你们到的万国里，你们剩下的人数稀少。
4.en: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will lead you away.

4.zh: 在那里，你们必事奉人手所造的神，就是用木石造成、不能看、不能听、不能吃、不能闻的神。
4.en: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

4.zh: 但你们在那里必寻求耶和华—你的　神。你尽心尽性寻求他的时候，就必寻见。
4.en: But from there you shall seek the LORD your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.

4.zh: 日后你遭遇一切患难的时候，你必归回耶和华—你的　神，听从他的话。
4.en: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to the LORD your God and listen to his voice.

4.zh: 耶和华—你　神原是有怜悯的　神；他总不撇下你，不灭绝你，也不忘记他起誓与你列祖所立的约。
4.en: For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

4.zh: 「你且考察在你以前的世代，自　神造人在世以来，从天这边到天那边，曾有何民听见　神在火中说话的声音，像你听见还能存活呢？这样的大事何曾有、何曾听见呢？
4.en: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?
Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

4.zh: 神何曾从别的国中将一国的人民领出来，用试验、神迹、奇事、争战、大能的手，和伸出来的膀臂，并大可畏的事，像耶和华—你们的　神在埃及，在你们眼前为你们所行的一切事呢？
4.en: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

4.zh: 这是显给你看，要使你知道，惟有耶和华—他是　神，除他以外，再无别神。
4.en: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God. There is no one else besides him.

4.zh: 他从天上使你听见他的声音，为要教训你，又在地上使你看见他的烈火，并且听见他从火中所说的话。
4.en: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.

4.zh: 因他爱你的列祖，所以拣选他们的后裔，用大能亲自领你出了埃及，
4.en: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

4.zh: 要将比你强大的国民从你面前赶出，领你进去，将他们的地赐你为业，像今日一样。
4.en: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.

4.zh: 所以，今日你要知道，也要记在心上，天上地下惟有耶和华他是　神，除他以外，再无别神。
4.en: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that the LORD himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.

4.zh: 我今日将他的律例诫命晓谕你，你要遵守，使你和你的子孙可以得福，并使你的日子在耶和华—你　神所赐的地上得以长久。」
4.en: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD your God gives you for all time.

4.zh: 「那时，摩西在约旦河东，向日出之地，分定三座城，
4.en: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,

4.zh: 使那素无仇恨、无心杀了人的，可以逃到这三城之中的一座城，就得存活：
4.en: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

4.zh: 为吕便人分定旷野平原的比悉；为迦得人分定基列的拉末；为玛拿西人分定巴珊的哥兰。」
4.en: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

4.zh: 摩西在以色列人面前所陈明的律法—
4.en: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

4.zh: 就是摩西在以色列人出埃及后所传给他们的法度、律例、典章；
4.en: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,

4.zh: 在约旦河东伯·毗珥对面的谷中，在住希实本、亚摩利王西宏之地；这西宏是摩西和以色列人出埃及后所击杀的。
4.en: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.

4.zh: 他们得了他的地，又得了巴珊王噩的地，就是两个亚摩利王，在约旦河东向日出之地。
4.en: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;

4.zh: 从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥，直到西云山，就是黑门山。
4.en: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),

4.zh: 还有约旦河东的全亚拉巴，直到亚拉巴海，靠近毗斯迦山根。
4.en: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

5.zh: 摩西将以色列众人召了来，对他们说：「以色列人哪，我今日晓谕你们的律例典章，你们要听，可以学习，谨守遵行。
5.en: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”

5.zh: 耶和华—我们的　神在何烈山与我们立约。
5.en: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

5.zh: 这约不是与我们列祖立的，乃是与我们今日在这里存活之人立的。
5.en: The LORD didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.

5.zh: 耶和华在山上，从火中，面对面与你们说话—
5.en: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,

5.zh: 那时我站在耶和华和你们中间，要将耶和华的话传给你们；因为你们惧怕那火，没有上山—说：
5.en: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the LORD’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,

5.zh: 「『我是耶和华—你的　神，曾将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来。
5.en: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

5.zh: 「『除了我以外，你不可有别的神。
5.en: “You shall have no other gods before me.

5.zh: 「『不可为自己雕刻偶像，也不可做什么[形象]，仿佛上天、下地和地底下、水中的[百物]。
5.en: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

5.zh: 不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因为我耶和华—你的　神是忌邪的　神。恨我的，我必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三、四代；
5.en: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me

5.zh: 爱我、守我诫命的，我必向他们发慈爱，直到千代。
5.en: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

5.zh: 「『不可妄称耶和华—你　神的名；因为妄称耶和华名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。
5.en: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

5.zh: 「『当照耶和华—你　神所吩咐的守安息日为圣日。
5.en: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.

5.zh: 六日要劳碌做你一切的工，
5.en: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;

5.zh: 但第七日是向耶和华—你　神当守的安息日。[这一日]，你和你的儿女、仆婢、牛、驴、牲畜，并在你城里寄居的客旅，无论何工都不可做，使你的仆婢可以和你一样安息。
5.en: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.

5.zh: 你也要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆；耶和华—你　神用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂将你从那里领出来。因此，耶和华—你的　神吩咐你守安息日。
5.en: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

5.zh: 「『当照耶和华—你　神所吩咐的孝敬父母，使你得福，并使你的日子在耶和华—你　神所赐你的地上得以长久。
5.en: “Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

5.zh: 「『不可杀人。
5.en: “You shall not murder.

5.zh: 「『不可奸淫。
5.en: “You shall not commit adultery.

5.zh: 「『不可偷盗。
5.en: “You shall not steal.

5.zh: 「『不可作假见证陷害人。
5.en: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

5.zh: 「『不可贪恋人的妻子；也不可贪图人的房屋、田地、仆婢、牛、驴，并他一切所有的。』
5.en: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”

5.zh: 「这些话是耶和华在山上，从火中、云中、幽暗中，大声晓谕你们全会众的；此外并没有添别的话。他就把这话写在两块石版上，交给我了。」
5.en: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.

5.zh: 「那时，火焰烧山，你们听见从黑暗中出来的声音；你们支派中所有的首领和长老都来就近我，
5.en: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

5.zh: 说：『看哪，耶和华—我们　神将他的荣光和他的大能显给我们看，我们又听见他的声音从火中出来。今日我们得见　神与人说话，人还存活。
5.en: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.

5.zh: 现在这大火将要烧灭我们，我们何必冒死呢？若再听见耶和华—我们　神的声音就必死亡。
5.en: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the LORD our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.

5.zh: 凡属血气的，曾有何人听见永生　神的声音从火中出来，像我们听见还能存活呢？
5.en: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?

5.zh: 求你近前去，听耶和华—我们　神所要说的一切话，将他对你说的话都传给我们，我们就听从遵行。』
5.en: Go near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say, and tell us all that the LORD our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”

5.zh: 「你们对我说的话，耶和华都听见了。耶和华对我说：『这百姓的话，我听见了；他们所说的都是。
5.en: The LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and the LORD said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.

5.zh: 惟愿他们存这样的心敬畏我，常遵守我的一切诫命，使他们和他们的子孙永远得福。
5.en: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!

5.zh: 你去对他们说：你们回帐棚去吧！
5.en: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’

5.zh: 至于你，可以站在我这里，我要将一切诫命、律例、典章传给你；你要教训他们，使他们在我赐他们为业的地上遵行。』
5.en: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”

5.zh: 所以，你们要照耶和华—你们　神所吩咐的谨守遵行，不可偏离左右。
5.en: You shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.

5.zh: 耶和华—你们　神所吩咐你们行的，你们都要去行，使你们可以存活得福，并使你们的日子在所要承受的地上得以长久。」
5.en: You shall walk in all the way which the LORD your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.

6.zh: 「这是耶和华—你们　神所吩咐教训你们的诫命、律例、典章，使你们在所要过去得为业的地上遵行，
6.en: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;

6.zh: 好叫你和你子子孙孙一生敬畏耶和华—你的　神，谨守他的一切律例诫命，就是我所吩咐你的，使你的日子得以长久。
6.en: that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

6.zh: 以色列啊，你要听，要谨守遵行，使你可以在那流奶与蜜之地得以享福，人数极其增多，正如耶和华—你列祖的　神所应许你的。
6.en: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

6.zh: 「以色列啊，你要听！耶和华—我们　神是独一的主。
6.en: Hear, Israel: The LORD is our God. The LORD is one.

6.zh: 你要尽心、尽性、尽力爱耶和华—你的　神。
6.en: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

6.zh: 我今日所吩咐你的话都要记在心上，
6.en: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

6.zh: 也要殷勤教训你的儿女。无论你坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，起来，都要谈论。
6.en: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

6.zh: 也要系在手上为记号，戴在额上为经文；
6.en: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

6.zh: 又要写在你房屋的门框上，并你的城门上。」
6.en: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

6.zh: 「耶和华—你的　神领你进他向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许给你的地。那里有城邑，又大又美，非你所建造的；
6.en: It shall be, when the LORD your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,

6.zh: 有房屋，装满各样美物，非你所装满的；有凿成的水井，非你所凿成的；还有葡萄园、橄榄园，非你所栽种的；你吃了而且饱足。
6.en: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;

6.zh: 那时你要谨慎，免得你忘记将你从埃及地、为奴之家领出来的耶和华。
6.en: then beware lest you forget the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

6.zh: 你要敬畏耶和华—你的　神，事奉他，指着他的名起誓。
6.en: You shall fear the LORD your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.

6.zh: 不可随从别神，就是你们四围国民的神；
6.en: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,

6.zh: 因为在你们中间的耶和华—你　神是忌邪的　神，惟恐耶和华—你　神的怒气向你发作，就把你从地上除灭。
6.en: for the LORD your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of the LORD your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.

6.zh: 「你们不可试探耶和华—你们的　神，像你们在玛撒那样试探他。
6.en: You shall not tempt the LORD your God, as you tempted him in Massah.

6.zh: 要留意遵守耶和华—你们　神所吩咐的诫命、法度、律例。
6.en: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

6.zh: 耶和华眼中看为正、看为善的，你都要遵行，使你可以享福，并可以进去得耶和华向你列祖起誓应许的那美地，
6.en: You shall do that which is right and good in the LORD’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to your fathers,

6.zh: 照耶和华所说的，从你面前撵出你的一切仇敌。
6.en: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.

6.zh: 「日后，你的儿子问你说：『耶和华—我们　神吩咐你们的这些法度、律例、典章是什么意思呢？』
6.en: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which the LORD our God has commanded you mean?”

6.zh: 你就告诉你的儿子说：『我们在埃及作过法老的奴仆；耶和华用大能的手将我们从埃及领出来，
6.en: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;

6.zh: 在我们眼前，将重大可怕的神迹奇事施行在埃及地和法老并他全家的身上，
6.en: and the LORD showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;

6.zh: 将我们从那里领出来，要领我们进入他向我们列祖起誓应许之地，把这地赐给我们。
6.en: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.

6.zh: 耶和华又吩咐我们遵行这一切律例，要敬畏耶和华—我们的　神，使我们常得好处，蒙他保全我们的生命，像今日一样。
6.en: The LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.

6.zh: 我们若照耶和华—我们　神所吩咐的一切诫命谨守遵行，这就是我们的义了。』」
6.en: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us.”

7.zh: 「耶和华—你　神领你进入要得为业之地，从你面前赶出许多国民，就是赫人、革迦撒人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，共七国的民，都比你强大。
7.en: When the LORD your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;

7.zh: 耶和华—你　神将他们交给你击杀，那时你要把他们灭绝净尽，不可与他们立约，也不可怜恤他们。
7.en: and when the LORD your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.

7.zh: 不可与他们结亲。不可将你的女儿嫁他们的儿子，也不可叫你的儿子娶他们的女儿；
7.en: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.

7.zh: 因为他必使你儿子转离不跟从主，去事奉别神，以致耶和华的怒气向你们发作，就速速地将你们灭绝。
7.en: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So the LORD’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.

7.zh: 你们却要这样待他们：拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，砍下他们的木偶，用火焚烧他们雕刻的偶像。
7.en: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.

7.zh: 因为你归耶和华—你　神为圣洁的民；耶和华—你　神从地上的万民中拣选你，特作自己的子民。
7.en: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

7.zh: 「耶和华专爱你们，拣选你们，并非因你们的人数多于别民，原来你们的人数在万民中是最少的。
7.en: The LORD didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;

7.zh: 只因耶和华爱你们，又因要守他向你们列祖所起的誓，就用大能的手领你们出来，从为奴之家救赎你们脱离埃及王法老的手。
7.en: but because the LORD loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, the LORD has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

7.zh: 所以，你要知道耶和华—你的　神，他是　神，是信实的　神；向爱他、守他诫命的人守约，施慈爱，直到千代；
7.en: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,

7.zh: 向恨他的人当面报应他们，将他们灭绝。凡恨他的人必报应他们，决不迟延。
7.en: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.

7.zh: 所以，你要谨守遵行我今日所吩咐你的诫命、律例、典章。」
7.en: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.

7.zh: 「你们果然听从这些典章，谨守遵行，耶和华—你　神就必照他向你列祖所起的誓守约，施慈爱。
7.en: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that the LORD your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.

7.zh: 他必爱你，赐福与你，使你人数增多，也必在他向你列祖起誓应许给你的地上赐福与你身所生的，地所产的，并你的五谷、新酒，和油，以及牛犊、羊羔。
7.en: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.

7.zh: 你必蒙福胜过万民；你们的男女没有不能生养的，牲畜也没有不能生育的。
7.en: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.

7.zh: 耶和华必使一切的病症离开你；你所知道埃及各样的恶疾，他不加在你身上，只加在一切恨你的人身上。
7.en: The LORD will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.

7.zh: 耶和华—你　神所要交给你的一切人民，你要将他们除灭；你眼不可顾惜他们。你也不可事奉他们的神，因这必成为你的网罗。
7.en: You shall consume all the peoples whom the LORD your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.

7.zh: 「你若心里说，这些国的民比我更多，我怎能赶出他们呢？
7.en: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”

7.zh: 你不要惧怕他们，要牢牢记念耶和华—你　神向法老和埃及全地所行的事，
7.en: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:

7.zh: 就是你亲眼所看见的大试验、神迹、奇事，和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂，都是耶和华—你　神领你出来所用的。耶和华—你　神必照样待你所惧怕的一切人民。
7.en: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD your God brought you out. So shall the LORD your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.

7.zh: 并且耶和华—你　神必打发黄蜂飞到他们中间，直到那剩下而藏躲的人从你面前灭亡。
7.en: Moreover the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.

7.zh: 你不要因他们惊恐，因为耶和华—你　神在你们中间是大而可畏的　神。
7.en: You shall not be scared of them; for the LORD your God is among you, a great and awesome God.

7.zh: 耶和华—你　神必将这些国的民从你面前渐渐赶出；你不可把他们速速灭尽，恐怕野地的兽多起来害你。
7.en: The LORD your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.

7.zh: 耶和华—你　神必将他们交给你，大大地扰乱他们，直到他们灭绝了；
7.en: But the LORD your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.

7.zh: 又要将他们的君王交在你手中，你就使他们的名从天下消灭。必无一人能在你面前站立得住，直到你将他们灭绝了。
7.en: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

7.zh: 他们雕刻的神像，你们要用火焚烧；其上的金银，你不可贪图，也不可收取，免得你因此陷入网罗；这原是耶和华—你　神所憎恶的。
7.en: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.

7.zh: 可憎的物，你不可带进家去；不然，你就成了当毁灭的，与那物一样。你要十分厌恶，十分憎嫌，因为这是当毁灭的物。」
7.en: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.

8.zh: 「我今日所吩咐的一切诫命，你们要谨守遵行，好叫你们存活，人数增多，且进去得耶和华向你们列祖起誓应许的那地。
8.en: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.

8.zh: 你也要记念耶和华—你的　神在旷野引导你这四十年，是要苦炼你，试验你，要知道你心内如何，肯守他的诫命不肯。
8.en: You shall remember all the way which the LORD your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

8.zh: 他苦炼你，任你饥饿，将你和你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，使你知道，人活着不是单靠食物，乃是靠耶和华口里所出的一切话。
8.en: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.

8.zh: 这四十年，你的衣服没有穿破，你的脚也没有肿。
8.en: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.

8.zh: 你当心里思想，耶和华—你　神管教你，好像人管教儿子一样。
8.en: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.

8.zh: 你要谨守耶和华—你　神的诫命，遵行他的道，敬畏他。
8.en: You shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

8.zh: 因为耶和华—你　神领你进入美地，那地有河，有泉，有源，从山谷中流出水来。
8.en: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;

8.zh: 那地有小麦、大麦、葡萄树、无花果树、石榴树、橄榄树，和蜜。
8.en: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;

8.zh: 你在那地不缺食物，一无所缺。那地的石头是铁，山内可以挖铜。
8.en: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

8.zh: 你吃得饱足，就要称颂耶和华—你的　神，因他将那美地赐给你了。」
8.en: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.

8.zh: 「你要谨慎，免得忘记耶和华—你的　神，不守他的诫命、典章、律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的；
8.en: Beware lest you forget the LORD your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

8.zh: 恐怕你吃得饱足，建造美好的房屋居住，
8.en: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;

8.zh: 你的牛羊加多，你的金银增添，并你所有的全都加增，
8.en: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

8.zh: 你就心高气傲，忘记耶和华—你的　神，就是将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来的，
8.en: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

8.zh: 引你经过那大而可怕的旷野，[那里]有火蛇、蝎子、干旱无水之地。他曾为你使水从坚硬的磐石中流出来，
8.en: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;

8.zh: 又在旷野将你列祖所不认识的吗哪赐给你吃，是要苦炼你，试验你，叫你终久享福；
8.en: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;

8.zh: [恐怕]你心里说：『这货财是我力量、我能力得来的。』
8.en: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”

8.zh: 你要记念耶和华—你的　神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的，为要坚定他向你列祖起誓所立的约，像今日一样。
8.en: But you shall remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.

8.zh: 你若忘记耶和华—你的　神，随从别神，事奉敬拜，你们必定灭亡；这是我今日警戒你们的。
8.en: It shall be, if you shall forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

8.zh: 耶和华在你们面前怎样使列国的民灭亡，你们也必照样灭亡，因为你们不听从耶和华—你们　神的话。」
8.en: As the nations that the LORD makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

9.zh: 「以色列啊，你当听！你今日要过约旦河，进去赶出比你强大的国民，得着广大坚固、高得顶天的城邑。
9.en: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,

9.zh: 那民是亚衲族的人，又大又高，是你所知道的；也曾听见有人指着他们说：『谁能在亚衲族人面前站立得住呢？』
9.en: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”

9.zh: 你今日当知道，耶和华—你的　神在你前面过去，如同烈火，要灭绝他们，将他们制伏在你面前。这样，你就要照耶和华所说的赶出他们，使他们速速灭亡。
9.en: Know therefore today that the LORD your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as the LORD has spoken to you.

9.zh: 「耶和华—你的　神将这些国民从你面前撵出以后，你心里不可说：『耶和华将我领进来得这地是因我的义。』其实，耶和华将他们从你面前赶出去是因他们的恶。
9.en: Don’t say in your heart, after the LORD your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land;” because the LORD drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.

9.zh: 你进去得他们的地，并不是因你的义，也不是因你心里正直，乃是因这些国民的恶，耶和华—你的　神将他们从你面前赶出去，又因耶和华要坚定他向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓所应许的话。
9.en: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

9.zh: 「你当知道，耶和华—你　神将这美地赐你为业，并不是因你的义；你本是硬着颈项的百姓。
9.en: Know therefore that the LORD your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.

9.zh: 你当记念不忘，你在旷野怎样惹耶和华—你　神发怒。自从你出了埃及地的那日，直到你们来到这地方，你们时常悖逆耶和华。
9.en: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.

9.zh: 你们在何烈山又惹耶和华发怒；他恼怒你们，要灭绝你们。
9.en: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, and the LORD was angry with you to destroy you.

9.zh: 我上了山，要领受两块石版，就是耶和华与你们立约的版。那时我在山上住了四十昼夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水。
9.en: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

9.zh: 耶和华把那两块石版交给我，是　神用指头写的。版上[所写的]是照耶和华在大会的日子、在山上、从火中对你们所说的一切话。
9.en: The LORD delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which the LORD spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.

9.zh: 过了四十昼夜，耶和华把那两块石版，就是约版，交给我。
9.en: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.

9.zh: 对我说：『你起来，赶快下去！因为你从埃及领出来的百姓已经败坏了自己；他们快快地偏离了我所吩咐的道，为自己铸成了偶像。』
9.en: The LORD said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”

9.zh: 「耶和华又对我说：『我看这百姓是硬着颈项的百姓。
9.en: Furthermore the LORD spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

9.zh: 你且由着我，我要灭绝他们，将他们的名从天下涂抹，使你的后裔比他们成为更大更强的国。』
9.en: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”

9.zh: 于是我转身下山，山被火烧着，两块约版在我两手之中。
9.en: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

9.zh: 我一看见你们得罪了耶和华—你们的　神，铸成了牛犊，快快地偏离了耶和华所吩咐你们的道，
9.en: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against the LORD your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which the LORD had commanded you.

9.zh: 我就把那两块版从我手中扔下去，在你们眼前摔碎了。
9.en: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

9.zh: 因你们所犯的一切罪，行了耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹他发怒，我就像从前俯伏在耶和华面前四十昼夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水。
9.en: I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

9.zh: 我因耶和华向你们大发烈怒，要灭绝你们，就甚害怕；但那次耶和华又应允了我。
9.en: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which the LORD was angry against you to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me that time also.

9.zh: 耶和华也向亚伦甚是发怒，要灭绝他；那时我又为亚伦祈祷。
9.en: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

9.zh: 我把那叫你们犯罪所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，又捣碎磨得很细，以致细如灰尘，我就把这灰尘撒在从山上流下来的溪水中。
9.en: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.

9.zh: 「你们在他备拉、玛撒、基博罗·哈他瓦又惹耶和华发怒。
9.en: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked the LORD to wrath.

9.zh: 耶和华打发你们离开加低斯·巴尼亚，说：『你们上去得我所赐给你们的地。』那时你们违背了耶和华—你们　神的命令，不信服他，不听从他的话。
9.en: When the LORD sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.

9.zh: 自从我认识你们以来，你们常常悖逆耶和华。
9.en: You have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

9.zh: 「我因耶和华说要灭绝你们，就在耶和华面前照旧俯伏四十昼夜。
9.en: So I fell down before the LORD the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because the LORD had said he would destroy you.

9.zh: 我祈祷耶和华说：『主耶和华啊，求你不要灭绝你的百姓。他们是你的产业，是你用大力救赎的，用大能从埃及领出来的。
9.en: I prayed to the LORD, and said, “Lord GOD, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

9.zh: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，不要想念这百姓的顽梗、邪恶、罪过，
9.en: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,

9.zh: 免得你领我们出来的那地之人说，耶和华因为不能将这百姓领进他所应许之地，又因恨他们，所以领他们出去，要在旷野杀他们。
9.en: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’

9.zh: 其实他们是你的百姓，你的产业，是你用大能和伸出来的膀臂领出来的。』」
9.en: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”

10.zh: 「那时，耶和华吩咐我说：『你要凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，上山到我这里来，又要做一木柜。
10.en: At that time the LORD said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

10.zh: 你先前摔碎的那版，其上的字我要写在这版上；你要将这版放在柜中。』
10.en: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

10.zh: 于是我用皂荚木做了一柜，又凿出两块石版，和先前的一样，手里拿这两块版上山去了。
10.en: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

10.zh: 耶和华将那大会之日、在山上从火中所传与你们的十条诫，照先前所写的，写在这版上，将版交给我了。
10.en: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.

10.zh: 我转身下山，将这版放在我所做的柜中，现今还在那里，正如耶和华所吩咐我的。」 （
10.en: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the LORD commanded me.

10.zh: 以色列人从比罗比尼·亚干起行，到了摩西拉。亚伦死在那里，就葬在那里。他儿子以利亚撒接续他供祭司的职分。
10.en: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

10.zh: 他们从那里起行，到了谷歌大，又从谷歌大到了有溪水之地的约巴他。
10.en: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

10.zh: 那时，耶和华将利未支派分别出来，抬耶和华的约柜，又侍立在耶和华面前事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到今日。
10.en: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

10.zh: 所以利未人在他弟兄中无分无业，耶和华是他的产业，正如耶和华—你　神所应许他的。
10.en: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD your God spoke to him.)

10.zh: 「我又像从前在山上住了四十昼夜。那次耶和华也应允我，不忍将你灭绝。
10.en: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me that time also. The LORD would not destroy you.

10.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：『你起来引导这百姓，使他们进去得我向他们列祖起誓应许所赐之地。』」
10.en: The LORD said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

10.zh: 「以色列啊，现在耶和华—你　神向你所要的是什么呢？只要你敬畏耶和华—你的　神，遵行他的道，爱他，尽心尽性事奉他，
10.en: Now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

10.zh: 遵守他的诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，为要叫你得福。
10.en: to keep the LORD’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

10.zh: 看哪，天和天上的天，地和地上所有的，都属耶和华—你的　神。
10.en: Behold, to the LORD your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

10.zh: 耶和华但喜悦你的列祖，爱他们，从万民中拣选他们的后裔，就是你们，像今日一样。
10.en: Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

10.zh: 所以你们要将心里的污秽除掉，不可再硬着颈项。
10.en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

10.zh: 因为耶和华—你们的　神—他是万神之神，万主之主，至大的　神，大有能力，大而可畏，不以貌取人，也不受贿赂。
10.en: For the LORD your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

10.zh: 他为孤儿寡妇伸冤，又怜爱寄居的，赐给他衣食。
10.en: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

10.zh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。
10.en: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

10.zh: 你要敬畏耶和华—你的　神，事奉他，专靠他，也要指着他的名起誓。
10.en: You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

10.zh: 他是你所赞美的，是你的　神，为你做了那大而可畏的事，是你亲眼所看见的。
10.en: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

10.zh: 你的列祖七十人下埃及；现在耶和华—你的　神使你如同天上的星那样多。」
10.en: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.

11.zh: 「你要爱耶和华—你的　神，常守他的吩咐、律例、典章、诫命。
11.en: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

11.zh: 你们今日当知道，我本不是和你们的儿女[说话]；因为他们不知道，也没有看见耶和华—你们　神的管教、威严、大能的手，和伸出来的膀臂，
11.en: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,

11.zh: 并他在埃及中向埃及王法老和其全地所行的神迹奇事；
11.en: his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;

11.zh: 也没有看见他怎样待埃及的军兵、车马，他们追赶你们的时候，耶和华怎样使红海的水淹没他们，将他们灭绝，直到今日，
11.en: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how the LORD has destroyed them to this day;

11.zh: 并他在旷野怎样待你们，以致你们来到这地方；
11.en: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;

11.zh: 也没有看见他怎样待吕便子孙以利押的儿子大坍、亚比兰，地怎样在以色列人中间开口，吞了他们和他们的家眷，并帐棚与跟他们的一切活物。
11.en: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the middle of all Israel;

11.zh: 惟有你们亲眼看见耶和华所做的一切大事。」
11.en: but your eyes have seen all of the LORD’s great work which he did.

11.zh: 「所以，你们要守我今日所吩咐的一切诫命，使你们胆壮，能以进去，得你们所要得的那地，
11.en: Therefore you shall keep the entire commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land that you go over to possess;

11.zh: 并使你们的日子在耶和华向你们列祖起誓、应许给他们和他们后裔的地上得以长久；那是流奶与蜜之地。
11.en: and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.

11.zh: 你要进去得为业的那地，本不像你出来的埃及地。你在那里撒种，用脚浇灌，像浇灌菜园一样。
11.en: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;

11.zh: 你们要过去得为业的那地乃是有山有谷、雨水滋润之地，
11.en: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,

11.zh: 是耶和华—你　神所眷顾的；从岁首到年终，耶和华—你　神的眼目时常看顾那地。
11.en: a land which the LORD your God cares for. The LORD your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

11.zh: 「你们若留意听从我今日所吩咐的诫命，爱耶和华—你们的　神，尽心尽性事奉他，
11.en: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

11.zh: 他必按时降秋雨春雨在你们的地上，使你们可以收藏五谷、新酒，和油，
11.en: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.

11.zh: 也必使你吃得饱足，并使田野为你的牲畜长草。
11.en: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.

11.zh: 你们要谨慎，免得心中受迷惑，就偏离[正路]，去事奉敬拜别神。
11.en: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;

11.zh: 耶和华的怒气向你们发作，就使天闭塞不下雨，地也不出产，使你们在耶和华所赐给你们的美地上速速灭亡。
11.en: and the LORD’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield its fruit; and you perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD gives you.

11.zh: 「你们要将我这话存在心内，留在意中，系在手上为记号，戴在额上为经文；
11.en: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

11.zh: 也要教训你们的儿女，无论坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，起来，都要谈论；
11.en: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

11.zh: 又要写在房屋的门框上，并城门上，
11.en: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;

11.zh: 使你们和你们子孙的日子在耶和华向你们列祖起誓、应许给他们的地上得以增多，如天覆地的日子那样多。
11.en: that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

11.zh: 你们若留意谨守遵行我所吩咐这一切的诫命，爱耶和华—你们的　神，行他的道，专靠他，
11.en: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you—to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him—

11.zh: 他必从你们面前赶出这一切国民，就是比你们更大更强的国民，你们也要得他们的地。
11.en: then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.

11.zh: 凡你们脚掌所踏之地都必归你们；从旷野和黎巴嫩，并幼发拉底大河，直到西海，都要作你们的境界。
11.en: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.

11.zh: 必无一人能在你们面前站立得住；耶和华—你们的　神必照他所说的，使惧怕惊恐临到你们所踏之地的居民。
11.en: No man will be able to stand before you. The LORD your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.

11.zh: 「看哪，我今日将祝福与咒诅的话都陈明在你们面前。
11.en: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

11.zh: 你们若听从耶和华—你们　神的诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你们的，就必蒙福。
11.en: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today;

11.zh: 你们若不听从耶和华—你们　神的诫命，偏离我今日所吩咐你们的道，去事奉你们素来所不认识的别神，就必受祸。
11.en: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

11.zh: 及至耶和华—你的　神领你进入要去得为业的那地，你就要将祝福的话陈明在基利心山上，将咒诅的话陈明在以巴路山上。
11.en: It shall happen, when the LORD your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

11.zh: 这二山岂不是在约旦河那边，日落之处，在住亚拉巴的迦南人之地与吉甲相对，靠近摩利橡树吗？
11.en: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

11.zh: 你们要过约旦河，进去得耶和华—你们　神所赐你们为业之地，在那地居住。
11.en: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

11.zh: 你们要谨守遵行我今日在你们面前所陈明的一切律例典章。」
11.en: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.

12.zh: 「你们存活于世的日子，在耶和华—你们列祖的　神所赐你们为业的地上，要谨守遵行的律例典章乃是这些：
12.en: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth.

12.zh: 你们要将所赶出的国民事奉神的各地方，无论是在高山，在小山，在各青翠树下，都毁坏了；
12.en: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

12.zh: 也要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，用火焚烧他们的木偶，砍下他们雕刻的神像，并将其名从那地方除灭。
12.en: You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of their gods. You shall destroy their name out of that place.

12.zh: 你们不可照他们那样事奉耶和华—你们的　神。
12.en: You shall not do so to the LORD your God.

12.zh: 但耶和华—你们的　神从你们各支派中选择何处为立他名的居所，你们就当往那里去求问，
12.en: But to the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.

12.zh: 将你们的燔祭、[平安]祭、十分取一之物，和手中的举祭，并还愿祭、甘心祭，以及牛群羊群中头生的，都奉到那里。
12.en: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.

12.zh: 在那里，耶和华—你们　神的面前，你们和你们的家属都可以吃，并且因你手所办的一切事蒙耶和华—你的　神赐福，就都欢乐。
12.en: There you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you.

12.zh: 我们今日在这里所行的是各人行自己眼中看为正的事，你们将来不可这样行；
12.en: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;

12.zh: 因为你们还没有到耶和华—你　神所赐你的安息[地]，所给你的产业。
12.en: for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which the LORD your God gives you.

12.zh: 但你们过了约旦河，得以住在耶和华—你们　神使你们承受为业之地，又使你们太平，不被四围的一切仇敌扰乱，安然居住。
12.en: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,

12.zh: 那时要将我所吩咐你们的燔祭、[平安]祭、十分取一之物，和手中的举祭，并向耶和华许愿献的一切美祭，都奉到耶和华—你们　神所选择要立为他名的居所。
12.en: then it shall happen that to the place which the LORD your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to the LORD.

12.zh: 你们和儿女、仆婢，并住在你们城里无分无业的利未人，都要在耶和华—你们的　神面前欢乐。
12.en: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

12.zh: 你要谨慎，不可在你所看中的各处献燔祭。
12.en: Be careful that you don’t offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see;

12.zh: 惟独耶和华从你那一支派中所选择的地方，你就要在那里献燔祭，行我一切所吩咐你的。
12.en: but in the place which the LORD chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

12.zh: 「然而，在你各城里都可以照耶和华—你　神所赐你的福分，随心所欲宰牲吃肉；无论洁净人不洁净人都可以吃，就如吃羚羊与鹿一般。
12.en: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to the LORD your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.

12.zh: 只是不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。
12.en: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

12.zh: 你的五谷、新酒，和油的十分之一，或是牛群羊群中头生的，或是你许愿献的，甘心献的，或是手中的举祭，都不可在你城里吃。
12.en: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vow, nor your free will offerings, nor the wave offering of your hand;

12.zh: 但要在耶和华—你的　神面前吃，在耶和华—你　神所要选择的地方，你和儿女、仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，都可以吃；也要因你手所办的，在耶和华—你　神面前欢乐。
12.en: but you shall eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God shall choose: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all that you put your hand to.

12.zh: 你要谨慎，在你所住的地方永不可丢弃利未人。
12.en: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.

12.zh: 「耶和华—你的　神照他所应许扩张你境界的时候，你心里想要吃肉，说：『我要吃肉』，就可以随心所欲地吃肉。
12.en: When the LORD your God enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.

12.zh: 耶和华—你　神所选择要立他名的地方若离你太远，就可以照我所吩咐的，将耶和华赐给你的牛羊取些宰了，可以随心所欲在你城里吃。
12.en: If the place which the LORD your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which the LORD has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul.

12.zh: 你吃那肉，要像吃羚羊与鹿一般；无论洁净人不洁净人都可以吃。
12.en: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.

12.zh: 只是你要心意坚定，不可吃血，因为血是生命；不可将血与肉同吃。
12.en: Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.

12.zh: 不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。
12.en: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

12.zh: 不可吃血。这样，你行耶和华眼中看为正的事，你和你的子孙就可以得福。
12.en: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in the LORD’s eyes.

12.zh: 只是你分别为圣的物和你的还愿祭要奉到耶和华所选择的地方去。
12.en: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which the LORD shall choose.

12.zh: 你的燔祭，连肉带血，都要献在耶和华—你　神的坛上。[平安]祭的血要倒在耶和华—你　神的坛上；[平安]祭的肉，你自己可以吃。
12.en: You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on the LORD your God’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the LORD your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.

12.zh: 你要谨守听从我所吩咐的一切话，行耶和华—你　神眼中看为善，看为正的事。这样，你和你的子孙就可以永远享福。」
12.en: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in the LORD your God’s eyes.

12.zh: 「耶和华—你　神将你要去赶出的国民从你面前剪除，你得了他们的地居住，
12.en: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,

12.zh: 那时就要谨慎，不可在他们除灭之后随从他们[的恶]俗，陷入网罗，也不可访问他们的神说：『这些国民怎样事奉他们的神，我也要照样行。』
12.en: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”

12.zh: 你不可向耶和华—你的　神这样行，因为他们向他们的神行了耶和华所憎嫌所恨恶的一切事，甚至将自己的儿女用火焚烧，献与他们的神。
12.en: You shall not do so to the LORD your God; for every abomination to the LORD, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

12.zh: 凡我所吩咐的，你们都要谨守遵行，不可加添，也不可删减。
12.en: Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

13.zh: 「你们中间若有先知或是做梦的起来，向你显个神迹奇事，
13.en: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

13.zh: 对你说：『我们去随从你素来所不认识的别神，事奉它吧。』他所显的神迹奇事虽有应验，
13.en: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”

13.zh: 你也不可听那先知或是那做梦之人的话；因为这是耶和华—你们的　神试验你们，要知道你们是尽心尽性爱耶和华—你们的　神不是。
13.en: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for the LORD your God is testing you, to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

13.zh: 你们要顺从耶和华—你们的　神，敬畏他，谨守他的诫命，听从他的话，事奉他，专靠他。
13.en: You shall walk after the LORD your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.

13.zh: 那先知或是那做梦的既用言语叛逆那领你们出埃及地、救赎你脱离为奴之家的耶和华—你们的　神，要勾引你离开耶和华—你　神所吩咐你行的道，你便要将他治死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
13.en: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which the LORD your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

13.zh: 「你的同胞弟兄，或是你的儿女，或是你怀中的妻，或是如同你性命的朋友，若暗中引诱你，说：『我们不如去事奉你和你列祖素来所不认识的别神—
13.en: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

13.zh: 是你四围列国的神。』无论是离你近，离你远，从地这边到地那边的神，
13.en: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth—

13.zh: 你不可依从他，也不可听从他，眼不可顾惜他。你不可怜恤他，也不可遮庇他，
13.en: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;

13.zh: 总要杀他；你先下手，然后众民也下手，将他治死。
13.en: but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.

13.zh: 要用石头打死他，因为他想要勾引你离开那领你出埃及地为奴之家的耶和华—你的　神。
13.en: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

13.zh: 以色列众人都要听见害怕，就不敢在你们中间再行这样的恶了。
13.en: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.

13.zh: 「在耶和华—你　神所赐你居住的各城中，你若听人说，有些匪类从你们中间的一座城出来勾引本城的居民，说：『我们不如去事奉你们素来所不认识的别神』；
13.en: If you hear about one of your cities, which the LORD your God gives you to dwell there, that
certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,

13.zh: 你就要探听，查究，细细地访问，果然是真，准有这可憎恶的事行在你们中间，
13.en: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,

13.zh: 你必要用刀杀那城里的居民，把城里所有的，连牲畜，都用刀杀尽。
13.en: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

13.zh: 你从那城里所夺的财物都要堆积在街市上，用火将城和其内所夺的财物都在耶和华—你　神面前烧尽；那城就永为荒堆，不可再建造。
13.en: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to the LORD your God. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

13.zh: 那当毁灭的物连一点都不可粘你的手。你要听从耶和华—你　神的话，遵守我今日所吩咐你的一切诫命，行耶和华—你　神眼中看为正的事，耶和华就必转意，不发烈怒，恩待你，怜恤你，照他向你列祖所起的誓使你人数增多。」
13.en: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,
