when you listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in the LORD your God’s eyes.

14.zh: 「你们是耶和华—你们　神的儿女。不可为死人用刀划身，也不可将额上剃光；
14.en: You are the children of the LORD your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

14.zh: 因为你归耶和华—你　神为圣洁的民，耶和华从地上的万民中拣选你特作自己的子民。」
14.en: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

14.zh: 「凡可憎的物都不可吃。
14.en: You shall not eat any abominable thing.

14.zh: 可吃的牲畜就是牛、绵羊、山羊、
14.en: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

14.zh: 鹿、羚羊、狍子、野山羊、麋鹿、黄羊、青羊。
14.en: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.

14.zh: 凡分蹄成为两瓣又倒嚼的走兽，你们都可以吃。
14.en: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.

14.zh: 但那些倒嚼或是分蹄之中不可吃的乃是骆驼、兔子、沙番—因为是倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
14.en: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.

14.zh: 猪—因为是分蹄却不倒嚼，就与你们不洁净。这些兽的肉，你们不可吃，死的也不可摸。
14.en: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.

14.zh: 「水中可吃的乃是这些：凡有翅有鳞的都可以吃；
14.en: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.

14.zh: 凡无翅无鳞的都不可吃，是与你们不洁净。
14.en: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

14.zh: 「凡洁净的鸟，你们都可以吃。
14.en: Of all clean birds you may eat.

14.zh: 不可吃的乃是雕、狗头雕、红头雕、
14.en: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,

14.zh: 鹯、小鹰、鹞鹰与其类，
14.en: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,

14.zh: 乌鸦与其类，
14.en: every raven of any kind,

14.zh: 鸵鸟、夜鹰、鱼鹰、鹰与其类，
14.en: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,

14.zh: 鸮鸟、猫头鹰、角鸱、
14.en: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,

14.zh: 鹈鹕、秃雕、鸬鹚、
14.en: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,

14.zh: 鹳、鹭鸶与其类，戴 与蝙蝠。
14.en: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.

14.zh: 凡有翅膀爬行的物是与你们不洁净，都不可吃。
14.en: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

14.zh: 凡洁净的鸟，你们都可以吃。
14.en: Of all clean birds you may eat.

14.zh: 「凡自死的，你们都不可吃，可以给你城里寄居的吃，或卖与外人吃，因为你是归耶和华—你　神为圣洁的民。 「不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。」
14.en: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

14.zh: 「你要把你撒种所产的，就是你田地每年所出的，十分取一分；
14.en: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

14.zh: 又要把你的五谷、新酒、和油的十分之一，并牛群羊群中头生的，吃在耶和华—你　神面前，就是他所选择要立为他名的居所。这样，你可以学习时常敬畏耶和华—你的　神。
14.en: You shall eat before the LORD your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.

14.zh: 当耶和华—你　神赐福与你的时候，耶和华—你　神所选择要立为他名的地方若离你太远，那路也太长，使你不能把这物带到那里去，
14.en: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which the LORD your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when the LORD your God blesses you,

14.zh: 你就可以换成银子，将银子包起来，拿在手中，往耶和华—你　神所要选择的地方去。
14.en: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.

14.zh: 你用这银子，随心所欲，或买牛羊，或买清酒浓酒，凡你心所想的都可以买；你和你的家属在耶和华—你　神的面前吃喝快乐。
14.en: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you. You shall eat there before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.

14.zh: 「住在你城里的利未人，你不可丢弃他，因为他在你们中间无分无业。
14.en: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

14.zh: 每逢三年的末一年，你要将本年的土产十分之一都取出来，积存在你的城中。
14.en: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.

14.zh: 在你城里无分无业的利未人，和你城里寄居的，并孤儿寡妇，都可以来，吃得饱足。这样，耶和华—你的　神必在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。」
14.en: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

15.zh: 「每逢七年末一年，你要施行豁免。
15.en: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.

15.zh: 豁免的定例乃是这样：凡债主要把所借给邻舍的豁免了；不可向邻舍和弟兄追讨，因为耶和华的豁免[年]已经宣告了。
15.en: This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because the LORD’s release has been proclaimed.

15.zh: 若借给外邦人，你可以向他追讨；但借给你弟兄，无论是什么，你要松手豁免了。
15.en: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.

15.zh: 你若留意听从耶和华—你　神的话，谨守遵行我今日所吩咐你这一切的命令，就必在你们中间没有穷人了（在耶和华—你　神所赐你为业的地上，耶和华必大大赐福与你。）
15.en: However there will be no poor with you (for the LORD will surely bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess)
if only you diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.

15.zh: 因为耶和华—你的　神必照他所应许你的赐福与你。你必借给许多国民，却不致向[他们]借贷；你必管辖许多国民，他们却不能管辖你。
15.en: For the LORD your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.

15.zh: 「在耶和华—你　神所赐你的地上，无论哪一座城里，你弟兄中若有一个穷人，你不可忍着心、揝着手不帮补你穷乏的弟兄。
15.en: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;

15.zh: 总要向他松开手，照他所缺乏的借给他，补他的不足。
15.en: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

15.zh: 你要谨慎，不可心里起恶念，说：『第七年的豁免年快到了』，你便恶眼看你穷乏的弟兄，什么都不给他，以致他因你求告耶和华，罪便归于你了。
15.en: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to the LORD against you, and it be sin to you.

15.zh: 你总要给他，给他的时候心里不可愁烦；因耶和华—你的　神必在你这一切所行的，并你手里所办的事上，赐福与你。
15.en: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.

15.zh: 原来那地上的穷人永不断绝；所以我吩咐你说：『总要向你地上困苦穷乏的弟兄松开手。』」
15.en: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.

15.zh: 「你弟兄中，若有一个希伯来男人或希伯来女人被卖给你，服事你六年，到第七年就要任他自由出去。
15.en: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

15.zh: 你任他自由的时候，不可使他空手而去，
15.en: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.

15.zh: 要从你羊群、禾场、酒榨之中多多地给他；耶和华—你的　神怎样赐福与你，你也要照样给他。
15.en: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As the LORD your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

15.zh: 要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆，耶和华—你的　神将你救赎；因此，我今日吩咐你这件事。
15.en: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

15.zh: 他若对你说：『我不愿意离开你』，是因他爱你和你的家，且因在你那里很好，
15.en: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,

15.zh: 你就要拿锥子将他的耳朵在门上刺透，他便永为你的奴仆了。你待婢女也要这样。
15.en: then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.

15.zh: 你任他自由的时候，不可以为难事，因他服事你六年，较比雇工的工价多加一倍了。耶和华—你的　神就必在你所做的一切事上赐福与你。」
15.en: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. The LORD your God will bless you in all that you do.

15.zh: 「你牛群羊群中头生的，凡是公的，都要分别为圣，归耶和华—你的　神。牛群中头生的，不可用它耕地；羊群中头生的，不可剪毛。
15.en: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to the LORD your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

15.zh: 这头生的，你和你的家属，每年要在耶和华所选择的地方，在耶和华—你　神面前吃。
15.en: You shall eat it before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, you and your household.

15.zh: 这头生的若有什么残疾，[就如]瘸腿的、瞎眼的，无论有什么恶残疾，都不可献给耶和华—你的　神；
15.en: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

15.zh: 可以在你城里吃；洁净人与不洁净人都[可以吃]，就如吃羚羊与鹿一般。
15.en: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.

15.zh: 只是不可吃它的血；要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。」
15.en: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.

16.zh: 「你要注意亚笔月，向耶和华—你的　神守逾越节，因为耶和华—你的　神在亚笔月夜间领你出埃及。
16.en: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to the LORD your God; for in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

16.zh: 你当在耶和华所选择要立为他名的居所，从牛群羊群中，将逾越[节的祭牲]献给耶和华—你的　神。
16.en: You shall sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

16.zh: 你吃[这祭牲]，不可吃有酵的饼；七日之内要吃无酵饼，就是困苦饼—你本是急忙出了埃及地—要叫你一生一世记念你从埃及地出来的日子。
16.en: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

16.zh: 在你四境之内，七日不可见面酵，头一日晚上所献的肉，一点不可留到早晨。
16.en: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.

16.zh: 在耶和华—你　神所赐的各城中，你不可献逾越[节的祭]；
16.en: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you;

16.zh: 只当在耶和华—你　神所选择要立为他名的居所，晚上日落的时候，乃是你出埃及的时候，献逾越[节的祭]。
16.en: but at the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.

16.zh: 当在耶和华—你　神所选择的地方把肉烤了吃，次日早晨就回到你的帐棚去。
16.en: You shall roast and eat it in the place which the LORD your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.

16.zh: 你要吃无酵饼六日，第七日要向耶和华—你的　神守严肃会，不可做工。」
16.en: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD your God. You shall do no work.

16.zh: 「你要计算七七日：从你开镰收割禾稼时算起，共计七七日。
16.en: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.

16.zh: 你要照耶和华—你　神所赐你的福，手里拿着甘心祭，献在耶和华—你的　神面前，守七七节。
16.en: You shall keep the feast of weeks to the LORD your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how the LORD your God blesses you.

16.zh: 你和你儿女、仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，以及在你们中间寄居的与孤儿寡妇，都要在耶和华—你　神所选择立为他名的居所，在耶和华—你的　神面前欢乐。
16.en: You shall rejoice before the LORD your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

16.zh: 你也要记念你在埃及作过奴仆。你要谨守遵行这些律例。」
16.en: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.

16.zh: 「你把禾场的[谷]、酒榨的[酒]收藏以后，就要守住棚节七日。
16.en: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.

16.zh: 守节的时候，你和你儿女、仆婢，并住在你城里的利未人，以及寄居的与孤儿寡妇，都要欢乐。
16.en: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.

16.zh: 在耶和华所选择的地方，你当向耶和华—你的　神守节七日；因为耶和华—你　神在你一切的土产上和你手里所办的事上要赐福与你，你就非常地欢乐。
16.en: You shall keep a feast to the LORD your God seven days in the place which the LORD chooses, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

16.zh: 你一切的男丁要在除酵节、七七节、住棚节，一年三次，在耶和华—你　神所选择的地方朝见他，却不可空手朝见。
16.en: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before the LORD your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before the LORD empty.

16.zh: 各人要按自己的力量，照耶和华—你　神所赐的福分，奉献礼物。」
16.en: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the LORD your God’s blessing which he has given you.

16.zh: 「你要在耶和华—你　神所赐的各城里，按着各支派设立审判官和官长。他们必按公义的审判判断百姓。
16.en: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which the LORD your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

16.zh: 不可屈枉正直；不可看人的外貌。也不可受贿赂；因为贿赂能叫智慧人的眼变瞎了，又能颠倒义人的话。
16.en: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

16.zh: 你要追求至公至义，好叫你存活，承受耶和华—你　神所赐你的地。
16.en: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you.

16.zh: 「你为耶和华—你的　神筑坛，不可在坛旁栽什么树木作为木偶。
16.en: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside the LORD your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.

16.zh: 也不可为自己设立柱像；这是耶和华—你　神所恨恶的。
16.en: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which the LORD your God hates.

17.zh: 「凡有残疾，或有什么恶病的牛羊，你都不可献给耶和华—你的　神，因为这是耶和华—你　神所憎恶的。
17.en: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to the LORD your God.

17.zh: 「在你们中间，在耶和华—你　神所赐你的诸城中，无论哪座城里，若有人，或男或女，行耶和华—你　神眼中看为恶的事，违背了他的约，
17.en: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,

17.zh: 去事奉敬拜别神，或拜日头，或拜月亮，或拜天象，是主不曾吩咐的；
17.en: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,

17.zh: 有人告诉你，你也听见了，就要细细地探听，果然是真，准有这可憎恶的事行在以色列中，
17.en: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,

17.zh: 你就要将行这恶事的男人或女人拉到城门[外]，用石头将他打死。
17.en: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.

17.zh: 要凭两三个人的口作见证将那当死的人治死；不可凭一个人的口作见证将他治死。
17.en: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

17.zh: 见证人要先下手，然后众民也下手将他治死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
17.en: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

17.zh: 「你城中若起了争讼的事，或因流血，或因争竞，或因殴打，是你难断的案件，你就当起来，往耶和华—你　神所选择的地方
17.en: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which the LORD your God chooses.

17.zh: 去见祭司利未人，并当时的审判官，求问他们，他们必将判语指示你。
17.en: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.

17.zh: 他们在耶和华所选择的地方指示你的判语，你必照着他们所指教你的一切话谨守遵行。
17.en: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which the LORD chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.

17.zh: 要按他们所指教你的律法，照他们所断定的去行；他们所指示你的判语，你不可偏离左右。
17.en: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.

17.zh: 若有人擅敢不听从那侍立在耶和华—你　神面前的祭司，或不听从审判官，那人就必治死；这样，便将那恶从以色列中除掉。
17.en: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before the LORD your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.

17.zh: 众百姓都要听见害怕，不再擅敢行事。」
17.en: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

17.zh: 「到了耶和华—你　神所赐你的地，得了那地居住的时候，若说：『我要立王治理我，像四围的国一样。』
17.en: When you have come to the land which the LORD your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”

17.zh: 你总要立耶和华—你　神所拣选的人为王。必从你弟兄中立一人；不可立你弟兄以外的人为王。
17.en: you shall surely set him whom the LORD your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.

17.zh: 只是王不可为自己加添马匹，也不可使百姓回埃及去，为要加添他的马匹，因耶和华曾吩咐你们说：『不可再回那条路去。』
17.en: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because the LORD has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”

17.zh: 他也不可为自己多立妃嫔，恐怕他的心偏邪；也不可为自己多积金银。
17.en: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

17.zh: 他登了国位，就要将祭司利未人面前的这律法[书]，为自己抄录一本，
17.en: It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.

17.zh: 存在他那里，要平生诵读，好学习敬畏耶和华—他的　神，谨守遵行这律法[书]上的一切言语和这些律例，
17.en: It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them;

17.zh: 免得他向弟兄心高气傲，偏左偏右，离了这诫命。这样，他和他的子孙便可在以色列中，在国位上年长日久。」
17.en: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.

18.zh: 「祭司利未人和利未全支派必在以色列中无分无业；他们所吃用的就是献给耶和华的火祭和一切所捐的。
18.en: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire and his portion.

18.zh: 他们在弟兄中必没有产业；耶和华是他们的产业，正如耶和华所应许他们的。
18.en: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. The LORD is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.

18.zh: 祭司从百姓所当得的分乃是这样：凡献牛或羊为祭的，要把前腿和两腮并脾胃给祭司。
18.en: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.

18.zh: 初收的五谷、新酒和油，并初剪的羊毛，也要给他；
18.en: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.

18.zh: 因为耶和华—你的　神从你各支派中将他拣选出来，使他和他子孙永远奉耶和华的名侍立，事奉。
18.en: For the LORD your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in the LORD’s name, him and his sons forever.

18.zh: 「利未人无论寄居在以色列中的哪一座城，若从那里出来，一心愿意到耶和华所选择的地方，
18.en: If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which the LORD shall choose,

18.zh: 就要奉耶和华—他　神的名事奉，像他众弟兄利未人侍立在耶和华面前事奉一样。
18.en: then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before the LORD.

18.zh: 除了他卖祖父产业所得的以外，还要得一分祭物与他们同吃。」
18.en: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.

18.zh: 「你到了耶和华—你　神所赐之地，那些国民所行可憎恶的事，你不可学着行。
18.en: When you have come into the land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.

18.zh: 你们中间不可有人使儿女经火，也不可有占卜的、观兆的、用法术的、行邪术的、
18.en: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,

18.zh: 用迷术的、交鬼的、行巫术的、过阴的。
18.en: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

18.zh: 凡行这些事的都为耶和华所憎恶；因那些国民行这可憎恶的事，所以耶和华—你的　神将他们从你面前赶出。
18.en: For whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD. Because of these abominations, the LORD your God drives them out from before you.

18.zh: 你要在耶和华—你的　神面前作完全人。」
18.en: You shall be blameless with the LORD your God.

18.zh: 「因你所要赶出的那些国民都听信观兆的和占卜的，至于你，耶和华—你的　神从来不许你这样行。
18.en: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, the LORD your God has not allowed you so to do.

18.zh: 耶和华—你的　神要从你们弟兄中间给你兴起一位先知，像我，你们要听从他。
18.en: The LORD your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.

18.zh: 正如你在何烈山大会的日子求耶和华—你　神一切的话，说：『求你不再叫我听见耶和华—我　神的声音，也不再叫我看见这大火，免得我死亡。』
18.en: This is according to all that you desired of the LORD your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again the LORD my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”

18.zh: 耶和华就对我说：『他们所说的是。
18.en: The LORD said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.

18.zh: 我必在他们弟兄中间给他们兴起一位先知，像你。我要将当说的话传给他；他要将我一切所吩咐的都传给他们。
18.en: I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.

18.zh: 谁不听他奉我名所说的话，我必讨谁的罪。
18.en: It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

18.zh: 若有先知擅敢托我的名说我所未曾吩咐他说的话，或是奉别神的名说话，那先知就必治死。』
18.en: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”

18.zh: 你心里若说：『耶和华所未曾吩咐的话，我们怎能知道呢？』
18.en: You may say in your heart, “How shall we know the word which the LORD has not spoken?”

18.zh: 先知托耶和华的名说话，所说的若不成就，也无效验，这就是耶和华所未曾吩咐的，是那先知擅自说的，你不要怕他。」
18.en: When a prophet speaks in the LORD’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which the LORD has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.

19.zh: 「耶和华—你　神将列国之民剪除的时候，耶和华—你　神也将他们的地赐给你，你接着住他们的城邑并他们的房屋，
19.en: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations whose land the LORD your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,

19.zh: 就要在耶和华—你　神所赐你为业的地上分定三座城。
19.en: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which the LORD your God gives you to possess.

19.zh: 要将耶和华—你　神使你承受为业的地分为三段；又要预备道路，使误杀人的，都可以逃到那里去。
19.en: You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land which the LORD your God causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.

19.zh: 「误杀人的逃到那里可以存活，定例乃是这样：凡素无仇恨，无心杀了人的，
19.en: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him in time past—

19.zh: 就如人与邻舍同入树林砍伐树木，手拿斧子一砍，本想砍下树木，不料，斧头脱了把，飞落在邻舍身上，以致于死，这人逃到那些城的一座城，就可以存活，
19.en: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live.

19.zh: 免得报血仇的，心中火热追赶他，因路远就追上，将他杀死；其实他不该死，因为他与被杀的素无仇恨。
19.en: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally, even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.

19.zh: 所以我吩咐你说，要分定三座城。
19.en: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.

19.zh: 耶和华—你　神若照他向你列祖所起的誓扩张你的境界，将所应许赐你列祖的地全然给你，
19.en: If the LORD your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;

19.zh: 你若谨守遵行我今日所吩咐的这一切诫命，爱耶和华—你的　神，常常遵行他的道，就要在这三座城之外，再添三座城，
19.en: and if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love the LORD your God, and to walk ever in his ways, then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, in addition to these three.

19.zh: 免得无辜之人的血流在耶和华—你　神所赐你为业的地上，流血的罪就归于你。
19.en: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.

19.zh: 「若有人恨他的邻舍，埋伏着起来击杀他，以致于死，便逃到这些城的一座城，
19.en: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;

19.zh: 本城的长老就要打发人去，从那里带出他来，交在报血仇的手中，将他治死。
19.en: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

19.zh: 你眼不可顾惜他，却要从以色列中除掉流无辜血的罪，使你可以得福。」
19.en: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you.

19.zh: 「在耶和华—你　神所赐你承受为业之地，不可挪移你邻舍的地界，那是先人所定的。」
19.en: You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that the LORD your God gives you to possess.

19.zh: 「人无论犯什么罪，作什么恶，不可凭一个人的口作见证，总要凭两三个人的口作见证才可定案。
19.en: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.

19.zh: 若有凶恶的见证人起来，见证某人作恶，
19.en: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,

19.zh: 这两个争讼的人就要站在耶和华面前，和当时的祭司，并审判官面前，
19.en: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;

19.zh: 审判官要细细地查究，若见证人果然是作假见证的，以假见证陷害弟兄，
19.en: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother,

19.zh: 你们就要待他如同他想要待的弟兄。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
19.en: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

19.zh: 别人听见都要害怕，就不敢在你们中间再行这样的恶了。
19.en: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.

19.zh: 你眼不可顾惜，要以命偿命，以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚。」
19.en: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

20.zh: 「你出去与仇敌争战的时候，看见马匹、车辆，并有比你多的人民，不要怕他们，因为领你出埃及地的耶和华—你　神与你同在。
20.en: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for the LORD your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, is with you.

20.zh: 你们将要上阵的时候，祭司要到百姓面前宣告
20.en: It shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,

20.zh: 说：『以色列人哪，你们当听，你们今日将要与仇敌争战，不要胆怯，不要惧怕战兢，也不要因他们惊恐；
20.en: and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;

20.zh: 因为耶和华—你们的　神与你们同去，要为你们与仇敌争战，拯救你们。』
20.en: for the LORD your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”

20.zh: 官长也要对百姓宣告说：『谁建造房屋，尚未奉献，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去奉献。
20.en: The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.

20.zh: 谁种葡萄园，尚未用所结的果子，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去用。
20.en: What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.

20.zh: 谁聘定了妻，尚未迎娶，他可以回家去，恐怕他阵亡，别人去娶。』
20.en: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”

20.zh: 官长又要对百姓宣告说：『谁惧怕胆怯，他可以回家去，恐怕他弟兄的心消化，和他一样。』
20.en: The officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, “What man is there who is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brother’s heart melt as his heart.”

20.zh: 官长对百姓宣告完了，就当派军长率领他们。
20.en: It shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people.

20.zh: 「你临近一座城、要攻打的时候，先要对城[里的民]宣告和睦的话。
20.en: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.

20.zh: 他们若以和睦的话回答你，给你开了城，城里所有的人都要给你效劳，服事你；
20.en: It shall be, if it gives you answer of peace and opens to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.

20.zh: 若不肯与你和好，反要与你打仗，你就要围困那城。
20.en: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

20.zh: 耶和华—你的　神把城交付你手，你就要用刀杀尽这城的男丁。
20.en: When the LORD your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;

20.zh: 惟有妇女、孩子、牲畜，和城内一切的财物，你可以取为自己的掠物。耶和华—你　神把你仇敌的财物赐给你，你可以吃用。
20.en: but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of your enemies, which the LORD your God has given you.

20.zh: 离你甚远的各城，不是这些国民的城，你都要这样待他。
20.en: Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.

20.zh: 但这些国民的城，耶和华—你　神既赐你为业，其中凡有气息的，一个不可存留；
20.en: But of the cities of these peoples that the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;

20.zh: 只要照耶和华—你　神所吩咐的将这赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人都灭绝净尽，
20.en: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as the LORD your God has commanded you;

20.zh: 免得他们教导你们学习一切可憎恶的事，就是他们向自己神所行的，以致你们得罪耶和华—你们的　神。
20.en: that they not teach you to follow all their abominations, which they have done for their gods; so would you sin against the LORD your God.

20.zh: 「你若许久围困、攻打所要取的一座城，就不可举斧子砍坏树木；因为你可以吃那树上的果子，不可砍伐。田间的树木岂是人，叫你糟蹋吗？
20.en: When you shall besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat of them. You shall not cut them down, for is the tree of the field man, that it should be besieged by you?

20.zh: 惟独你所知道不是结果子的树木可以毁坏、砍伐，用以修筑营垒，攻击那与你打仗的城，直到攻塌了。」
20.en: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.

21.zh: 「在耶和华—你　神所赐你为业的地上，若遇见被杀的人倒在田野，不知道是谁杀的，
21.en: If someone is found slain in the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,

21.zh: 长老和审判官就要出去，从被杀的人那里量起，直量到四围的城邑，
21.en: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.

21.zh: 看哪城离被杀的人最近，那城的长老就要从牛群中取一只未曾耕地、未曾负轭的母牛犊，
21.en: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.

21.zh: 把母牛犊牵到流水、未曾耕种的山谷去，在谷中打折母牛犊的颈项。
21.en: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.

21.zh: 祭司利未的子孙要近前来；因为耶和华—你的　神拣选了他们事奉他，奉耶和华的名祝福，所有争讼殴打的事都要凭他们判断。
21.en: The priests the sons of Levi shall come near, for them the LORD your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in the LORD’s name; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.

21.zh: 那城的众长老，就是离被杀的人最近的，要在那山谷中，在所打折颈项的母牛犊以上洗手，
21.en: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.

21.zh: 祷告说：『我们的手未曾流这[人的]血；我们的眼也未曾看见这事。
21.en: They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.

21.zh: 耶和华啊，求你赦免你所救赎的以色列民，不要使流无辜血的罪归在你的百姓以色列中间。』这样，流血的罪必得赦免。
21.en: Forgive, LORD, your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and don’t allow innocent blood among your people Israel.” The blood shall be forgiven them.

21.zh: 你行耶和华眼中看为正的事，就可以从你们中间除掉流无辜血的罪。」
21.en: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in the LORD’s eyes.

21.zh: 「你出去与仇敌争战的时候，耶和华—你的　神将他们交在你手中，你就掳了他们去。
21.en: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and the LORD your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,

21.zh: 若在被掳的人中见有美貌的女子，恋慕她，要娶她为妻，
21.en: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,

21.zh: 就可以领她到你家里去；她便要剃头发，修指甲，
21.en: then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.

21.zh: 脱去被掳时所穿的衣服，住在你家里哀哭父母一个整月，然后可以与她同房。你作她的丈夫，她作你的妻子。
21.en: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

21.zh: 后来你若不喜悦她，就要由她随意出去，决不可为钱卖她，也不可当婢女待她，因为你玷污了她。」
21.en: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.

21.zh: 「人若有二妻，一为所爱，一为所恶，所爱的、所恶的都给他生了儿子，但长子是所恶之妻生的。
21.en: If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the hated, and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated,

21.zh: 到了把产业分给儿子承受的时候，不可将所爱之妻生的儿子立为长子，在所恶之妻生的儿子以上，
21.en: then it shall be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, who is the firstborn;

21.zh: 却要认所恶之妻生的儿子为长子，将产业多加一分给他；因这儿子是他力量强壮的时候生的，长子的名分本当归他。」
21.en: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.

21.zh: 「人若有顽梗悖逆的儿子，不听从父母的话，他们虽惩治他，他仍不听从，
21.en: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,

21.zh: 父母就要抓住他，将他带到本地的城门、本城的长老那里，
21.en: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.

21.zh: 对长老说：『我们这儿子顽梗悖逆，不听从我们的话，是贪食好酒的人。』
21.en: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”

21.zh: 本城的众人就要用石头将他打死。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉，以色列众人都要听见害怕。」
21.en: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.

21.zh: 「人若犯该死的罪，被治死了，你将他挂在木头上，
21.en: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,

21.zh: 他的尸首不可留在木头上过夜，必要当日将他葬埋，免得玷污了耶和华—你　神所赐你为业之地。因为被挂的人是在　神面前受咒诅的。
21.en: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is accursed of God. Don’t defile your land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.

22.zh: 「你若看见弟兄的牛或羊失迷了路，不可佯为不见，总要把它牵回来交给你的弟兄。
22.en: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

22.zh: 你弟兄若离你远，或是你不认识他，就要牵到你家去，留在你那里，等你弟兄来寻找就还给他。
22.en: If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.

22.zh: 你的弟兄无论失落什么，或是驴，或是衣服，你若遇见，都要这样行，不可佯为不见。
22.en: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.

22.zh: 你若看见弟兄的牛或驴跌倒在路上，不可佯为不见，总要帮助他拉起来。
22.en: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.

22.zh: 「妇女不可穿戴男子所穿戴的，男子也不可穿妇女的衣服，因为这样行都是耶和华—你　神所憎恶的。
22.en: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD your God.

22.zh: 「你若路上遇见鸟窝，或在树上或在地上，里头有雏或有蛋，母鸟伏在雏上或在蛋上，你不可连母带雏一并取去。
22.en: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.

22.zh: 总要放母，只可取雏；这样你就可以享福，日子得以长久。
22.en: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.

22.zh: 「你若建造房屋，要在房上的四围安栏杆，免得有人从房上掉下来，流血的罪就归于你家。
22.en: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.

22.zh: 「不可把两样种子种在你的葡萄园里，免得你撒种所结的和葡萄园的果子都要充公。
22.en: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.

22.zh: 不可并用牛、驴耕地。
22.en: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

22.zh: 不可穿羊毛、细麻两样搀杂料做的衣服。
22.en: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

22.zh: 「你要在所披的外衣上四围做 子。」
22.en: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.

22.zh: 「人若娶妻，与她同房之后恨恶她，
22.en: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,

22.zh: 信口说她，将丑名加在她身上，说：『我娶了这女子，与她同房，见她没有贞洁的凭据』；
22.en: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”

22.zh: 女子的父母就要把女子贞洁的凭据拿出来，带到本城门长老那里。
22.en: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

22.zh: 女子的父亲要对长老说：『我将我的女儿给这人为妻，他恨恶她，
22.en: The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.

22.zh: 信口说她，说：我见你的女儿没有贞洁的凭据；其实这就是我女儿贞洁的凭据。』父母就把那布铺在本城的长老面前。
22.en: Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

22.zh: 本城的长老要拿住那人，惩治他，
22.en: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.

22.zh: 并要罚他一百[舍客勒]银子，给女子的父亲，因为他将丑名加在以色列的一个处女身上。女子仍作他的妻，终身不可休她。
22.en: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

22.zh: 但这事若是真的，女子没有贞洁的凭据，
22.en: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,

22.zh: 就要将女子带到她父家的门口，本城的人要用石头将她打死；因为她在父家行了淫乱，在以色列中做了丑事。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
22.en: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

22.zh: 「若遇见人与有丈夫的妇人行淫，就要将奸夫淫妇一并治死。这样，就把那恶从以色列中除掉。
22.en: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.

22.zh: 「若有处女已经许配丈夫，有人在城里遇见她，与她行淫，
22.en: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,

22.zh: 你们就要把这二人带到本城门，用石头打死—女子是因为虽在城里却没有喊叫；男子是因为玷污别人的妻。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。
22.en: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

22.zh: 「若有男子在田野遇见已经许配人的女子，强与她行淫，只要将那男子治死。
22.en: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;

22.zh: 但不可办女子；她本没有该死的罪，这事就类乎人起来攻击邻舍，将他杀了一样。
22.en: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;

22.zh: 因为男子是在田野遇见那已经许配人的女子，女子喊叫，并无人救她。
22.en: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.

22.zh: 「若有男子遇见没有许配人的处女，抓住她，与她行淫，被人看见，
22.en: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,

22.zh: 这男子就要拿五十[舍客勒]银子给女子的父亲；因他玷污了这女子，就要娶她为妻，终身不可休她。
22.en: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.

22.zh: 「人不可娶继母为妻；不可掀开他父亲的衣襟。」
22.en: A man shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.

23.zh: 「凡外肾受伤的，或被阉割的，不可入耶和华的会。
23.en: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly.

23.zh: 「私生子不可入耶和华的会；他的子孙，直到十代，也不可入耶和华的会。
23.en: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into the LORD’s assembly.

23.zh: 「亚扪人或是摩押人不可入耶和华的会；他们的子孙，虽过十代，也永不可入耶和华的会。
23.en: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into the LORD’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into the LORD’s assembly forever,

23.zh: 因为你们出埃及的时候，他们没有拿食物和水在路上迎接你们，又因他们雇了美索不达米亚的毗夺人比珥的儿子巴兰来咒诅你们。
23.en: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.

23.zh: 然而耶和华—你的　神不肯听从巴兰，却使那咒诅的言语变为祝福的话，因为耶和华—你的　神爱你。
23.en: Nevertheless the LORD your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because the LORD your God loved you.

23.zh: 你一生一世永不可求他们的平安和他们的利益。
23.en: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.

23.zh: 「不可憎恶以东人，因为他是你的弟兄。不可憎恶埃及人，因为你在他的地上作过寄居的。
23.en: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.

23.zh: 他们第三代子孙可以入耶和华的会。」
23.en: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into the LORD’s assembly.

23.zh: 「你出兵攻打仇敌，就要远避诸恶。
23.en: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.

23.zh: 「你们中间，若有人夜间偶然梦遗，不洁净，就要出到营外，不可入营；
23.en: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;

23.zh: 到傍晚的时候，他要用水洗澡，及至日落了才可以入营。
23.en: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.

23.zh: 「你在营外也该定出一个地方作为便所。
23.en: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.

23.zh: 在你器械之中当预备一把锹，你出营外便溺以后，用以铲土，转身掩盖。
23.en: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;

23.zh: 因为耶和华—你的　神常在你营中行走，要救护你，将仇敌交给你，所以你的营理当圣洁，免得他见你那里有污秽，就离开你。」
23.en: for the LORD your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.

23.zh: 「若有奴仆脱了主人的手，逃到你那里，你不可将他交付他的主人。
23.en: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.

23.zh: 他必在你那里与你同住，在你的城邑中，要由他选择一个所喜悦的地方居住；你不可欺负他。
23.en: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.

23.zh: 「以色列的女子中不可有妓女；以色列的男子中不可有娈童。
23.en: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

23.zh: 娼妓所得的钱，或娈童所得的价，你不可带入耶和华—你　神的殿还愿，因为这两样都是耶和华—你　神所憎恶的。
23.en: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of the LORD your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to the LORD your God.

23.zh: 「你借给你弟兄的，或是钱财或是粮食，无论什么可生利的物，都不可取利。
23.en: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.

23.zh: 借给外邦人可以取利，只是借给你弟兄不可取利。这样，耶和华—你　神必在你所去得为业的地上和你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。
23.en: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.

23.zh: 「你向耶和华—你的　神许愿，偿还不可迟延；因为耶和华—你的　神必定向你追讨，你不偿还就有罪。
23.en: When you vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for the LORD your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.

23.zh: 你若不许愿，倒无罪。
23.en: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.

23.zh: 你嘴里所出的，就是你口中应许甘心所献的，要照你向耶和华—你　神所许的愿谨守遵行。
23.en: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to the LORD your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.

23.zh: 「你进了邻舍的葡萄园，可以随意吃饱了葡萄，只是不可装在器皿中。
23.en: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.

23.zh: 你进了邻舍站着的禾稼，可以用手摘穗子，只是不可用镰刀割取禾稼。」
23.en: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.

24.zh: 「人若娶妻以后，见她有什么不合理的事，不喜悦她，就可以写休书交在她手中，打发她离开夫家。
24.en: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.

24.zh: 妇人离开夫家以后，可以去嫁别人。
24.en: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.

24.zh: 后夫若恨恶她，写休书交在她手中，打发她离开夫家，或是娶她为妻的后夫死了，
24.en: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;

24.zh: 打发她去的前夫不可在妇人玷污之后再娶她为妻，因为这是耶和华所憎恶的；不可使耶和华—你　神所赐为业之地被玷污了。」
24.en: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to the LORD. You shall not cause the land to sin, which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance.

24.zh: 「新娶妻之人不可从军出征，也不可托他办理什么公事，可以在家清闲一年，使他所娶的妻快活。
24.en: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.

24.zh: 「不可拿人的[全]盘磨石或是上磨石作当头，因为这是拿[人的]命作当头。
24.en: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.

24.zh: 「若遇见人拐带以色列中的一个弟兄，当奴才待他，或是卖了他，那拐带人的就必治死。这样，便将那恶从你们中间除掉。
24.en: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

24.zh: 「在大麻风的灾病上，你们要谨慎，照祭司利未人一切所指教你们的留意遵行。我怎样吩咐他们，你们要怎样遵行。
24.en: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.

24.zh: 当记念出埃及后，在路上，耶和华—你　神向米利暗所行的事。
24.en: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.

24.zh: 「你借给邻舍，不拘是什么，不可进他家拿他的当头。
24.en: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.

24.zh: 要站在外面，等那向你借贷的人把当头拿出来交给你。
24.en: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.

24.zh: 他若是穷人，你不可留他的当头过夜。
24.en: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

24.zh: 日落的时候，总要把当头还他，使他用那件衣服盖着睡觉，他就为你祝福；这在耶和华—你　神面前就是你的义了。
24.en: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God.

24.zh: 「困苦穷乏的雇工，无论是你的弟兄或是在你城里寄居的，你不可欺负他。
24.en: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.

24.zh: 要当日给他工价，不可等到日落—因为他穷苦，把心放在工价上—恐怕他因你求告耶和华，罪便归你了。
24.en: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to the LORD, and it be sin to you.

24.zh: 「不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子；凡被杀的都为本身的罪。
24.en: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

24.zh: 「你不可向寄居的和孤儿屈枉正直，也不可拿寡妇的衣裳作当头。
24.en: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;

24.zh: 要记念你在埃及作过奴仆。耶和华—你的　神从那里将你救赎，所以我吩咐你这样行。
24.en: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

24.zh: 「你在田间收割庄稼，若忘下一捆，不可回去再取，要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。这样，耶和华—你　神必在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。
24.en: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

24.zh: 你打橄榄树，枝上剩下的，不可再打；要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。
24.en: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

24.zh: 你摘葡萄园的[葡萄]，所剩下的，不可再摘；要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇。
24.en: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

24.zh: 你也要记念你在埃及地作过奴仆，所以我吩咐你这样行。
24.en: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

25.zh: 「人若有争讼，来听审判，[审判官]就要定义人有理，定恶人有罪。
25.en: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.

25.zh: 恶人若该受责打，审判官就要叫他当面伏在地上，按着他的罪照数责打。
25.en: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.

25.zh: 只可打他四十下，不可过数；若过数，便是轻贱你的弟兄了。
25.en: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.

25.zh: 「牛在场上踹谷的时候，不可笼住它的嘴。」
25.en: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.

25.zh: 「弟兄同居，若死了一个，没有儿子，死人的妻不可出嫁外人，她丈夫的兄弟当尽弟兄的本分，娶她为妻，与她同房。
25.en: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.

25.zh: 妇人生的长子必归死兄的名下，免得他的名在以色列中涂抹了。
25.en: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.

25.zh: 那人若不愿意娶她哥哥的妻，他哥哥的妻就要到城门长老那里，说：『我丈夫的兄弟不肯在以色列中兴起他哥哥的名字，不给我尽弟兄的本分。』
25.en: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”

25.zh: 本城的长老就要召那人来问他，他若执意说：『我不愿意娶她』，
25.en: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”

25.zh: 他哥哥的妻就要当着长老到那人的跟前，脱了他的鞋，吐唾沫在他脸上，说：『凡不为哥哥建立家室的都要这样待他。』
25.en: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”

25.zh: 在以色列中，他的名必称为脱鞋之家。」
25.en: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”

25.zh: 「若有二人争斗，这人的妻近前来，要救她丈夫脱离那打她丈夫之人的手，抓住那人的下体，
25.en: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,

25.zh: 就要砍断妇人的手，眼不可顾惜她。
25.en: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.

25.zh: 「你囊中不可有一大一小两样的法码。
25.en: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.

25.zh: 你家里不可有一大一小两样的升斗。
25.en: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.

25.zh: 当用对准公平的法码，公平的升斗。这样，在耶和华—你　神所赐你的地上，你的日子就可以长久。
25.en: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

25.zh: 因为行非义之事的人都是耶和华—你　神所憎恶的。」
25.en: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to the LORD your God.

25.zh: 「你要记念你们出埃及的时候，亚玛力人在路上怎样待你。
25.en: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,

25.zh: 他们在路上遇见你，趁你疲乏困倦击杀你尽后边软弱的人，并不敬畏　神。
25.en: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.

25.zh: 所以耶和华—你　神使你不被四围一切的仇敌扰乱，在耶和华—你　神赐你为业的地上得享平安。那时，你要将亚玛力的名号从天下涂抹了，不可忘记。」
25.en: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.

26.zh: 「你进去得了耶和华—你　神所赐你为业之地居住，
26.en: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,

26.zh: 就要从耶和华—你　神赐你的地上将所收的各种初熟的土产取些来，盛在筐子里，往耶和华—你　神所选择要立为他名的居所去，
26.en: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that the LORD your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

26.zh: 见当时作祭司的，对他说：『我今日向耶和华—你　神明认，我已来到耶和华向我们列祖起誓应许赐给我们的地。』
26.en: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to the LORD your God, that I have come to the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.”

26.zh: 祭司就从你手里取过筐子来，放在耶和华—你　神的坛前。
26.en: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before the LORD your God’s altar.

26.zh: 你要在耶和华—你　神面前说：『我祖原是一个将亡的亚兰人，下到埃及寄居。他人口稀少，在那里却成了又大又强、人数很多的国民。
26.en: You shall answer and say before the LORD your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.

26.zh: 埃及人恶待我们，苦害我们，将苦工加在我们身上。
26.en: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.

26.zh: 于是我们哀求耶和华—我们列祖的　神，耶和华听见我们的声音，看见我们所受的困苦、劳碌、欺压，
26.en: Then we cried to the LORD, the God of our fathers. The LORD heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.

26.zh: 他就用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，并大可畏的事与神迹奇事，领我们出了埃及，
26.en: The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;

26.zh: 将我们领进这地方，把这流奶与蜜之地赐给我们。
26.en: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，现在我把你所赐给我地上初熟的土产奉了来。』随后你要把筐子放在耶和华—你　神面前，向耶和华—你的　神下拜。
26.en: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, the LORD, have given me.” You shall set it down before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God.

26.zh: 你和利未人，并在你们中间寄居的，要因耶和华—你　神所赐你和你家的一切福分欢乐。
26.en: You shall rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.

26.zh: 「每逢三年，就是十分取一之年，你取完了一切土产的十分之一，要分给利未人和寄居的，与孤儿寡妇，使他们在你城中可以吃得饱足。
26.en: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.

26.zh: 你又要在耶和华—你　神面前说：『我已将圣物从我家里拿出来，给了利未人和寄居的，与孤儿寡妇，是照你所吩咐我的一切命令。你的命令我都没有违背，也没有忘记。
26.en: You shall say before the LORD your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.

26.zh: 我守丧的时候，没有吃这圣物；不洁净的时候，也没有拿出来，又没有为死人送去。我听从了耶和华—我　神的话，都照你所吩咐的行了。
26.en: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to the LORD my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.

26.zh: 求你从天上、你的圣所垂看，赐福给你的百姓以色列与你所赐给我们的地，就是你向我们列祖起誓赐我们流奶与蜜之地。』」
26.en: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”

26.zh: 「耶和华—你的　神今日吩咐你行这些律例典章，所以你要尽心尽性谨守遵行。
26.en: Today the LORD your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

26.zh: 你今日认耶和华为你的　神，应许遵行他的道，谨守他的律例、诫命、典章，听从他的话。
26.en: You have declared today that the LORD is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.

26.zh: 耶和华今日照他所应许你的，也认你为他的子民，使你谨守他的一切诫命，
26.en: The LORD has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.

26.zh: 又使你得称赞、美名、尊荣，超乎他所造的万民之上，并照他所应许的使你归耶和华—你　神为圣洁的民。」
26.en: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God, as he has spoken.

27.zh: 摩西和以色列的众长老吩咐百姓说：「你们要遵守我今日所吩咐的一切诫命。
27.en: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.

27.zh: 你们过约旦河，到了耶和华—你　神所赐给你的地，当天要立起几块大石头，墁上石灰，
27.en: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.

27.zh: 把这律法的一切话写在石头上。你过了河，可以进入耶和华—你　神所赐你流奶与蜜之地，正如耶和华—你列祖之　神所应许你的。
27.en: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

27.zh: 你们过了约旦河，就要在以巴路山上照我今日所吩咐的，将这些石头立起来，墁上石灰。
27.en: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.

27.zh: 在那里要为耶和华—你的　神筑一座石坛；在石头上不可动铁[器]。
27.en: There you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.

27.zh: 要用没有凿过的石头筑耶和华—你　神的坛，在坛上要将燔祭献给耶和华—你的　神。
27.en: You shall build the LORD your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.

27.zh: 又要献平安祭，且在那里吃，在耶和华—你的　神面前欢乐。
27.en: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God.

27.zh: 你要将这律法的一切话明明地写在石头上。」
27.en: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”

27.zh: 摩西和祭司利未人晓谕以色列众人说：「以色列啊，要默默静听。你今日成为耶和华—你　神的百姓了。
27.en: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.

27.zh: 所以要听从耶和华—你　神的话，遵行他的诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的。」
27.en: You shall therefore obey the LORD your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”

27.zh: 当日，摩西嘱咐百姓说：
27.en: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

27.zh: 「你们过了约旦河，西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、约瑟、便雅悯六个支派的人都要站在基利心山上为百姓祝福。
27.en: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

27.zh: 吕便、迦得、亚设、西布伦、但、拿弗他利六个支派的人都要站在以巴路山上宣布咒诅。
27.en: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

27.zh: 利未人要向以色列众人高声说：
27.en: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,

27.zh: 「『有人制造耶和华所憎恶的偶像，或雕刻，或铸造，就是工匠手所做的，在暗中设立，那人必受咒诅！』百姓都要答应说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『轻慢父母的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『挪移邻舍地界的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『使瞎子走差路的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『向寄居的和孤儿寡妇屈枉正直的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『与继母行淫的，必受咒诅！因为掀开他父亲的衣襟。』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『与兽淫合的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『与异母同父，或异父同母的姊妹行淫的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『与岳母行淫的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『暗中杀人的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『受贿赂害死无辜之人的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

27.zh: 「『不坚守遵行这律法言语的，必受咒诅！』百姓都要说：『阿们！』」
27.en: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”

28.zh: 「你若留意听从耶和华—你　神的话，谨守遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，他必使你超乎天下万民之上。
28.en: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

28.zh: 你若听从耶和华—你　神的话，这以下的福必追随你，临到你身上：
28.en: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

28.zh: 你在城里必蒙福，在田间也必蒙福。
28.en: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

28.zh: 你身所生的，地所产的，牲畜所下的，以及牛犊、羊羔，都必蒙福。
28.en: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

28.zh: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必蒙福。
28.en: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

28.zh: 你出也蒙福，入也蒙福。
28.en: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.

28.zh: 「仇敌起来攻击你，耶和华必使他们在你面前被你杀败；他们从一条路来攻击你，必从七条路逃跑。
28.en: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.

28.zh: 在你仓房里，并你手所办的一切事上，耶和华所命的福必临到你。耶和华—你　神也要在所给你的地上赐福与你。
28.en: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

28.zh: 你若谨守耶和华—你　神的诫命，遵行他的道，他必照着向你所起的誓立你作为自己的圣民。
28.en: The LORD will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and walk in his ways.

28.zh: 天下万民见你归在耶和华的名下，就要惧怕你。
28.en: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the LORD’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

28.zh: 你在耶和华向你列祖起誓应许赐你的地上，他必使你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地所产的，都绰绰有余。
28.en: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.

28.zh: 耶和华必为你开天上的府库，按时降雨在你的地上。在你手里所办的一切事上赐福与你。你必借给许多国民，却不致向他们借贷。
28.en: The LORD will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

28.zh: 你若听从耶和华—你　神的诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的，谨守遵行，不偏左右，也不随从事奉别神，耶和华就必使你作首不作尾，但居上不居下。」
28.en: The LORD will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,
and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

28.zh: 「你若不听从耶和华—你　神的话，不谨守遵行他的一切诫命律例，就是我今日所吩咐你的，这以下的咒诅都必追随你，临到你身上：
28.en: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.

28.zh: 你在城里必受咒诅，在田间也必受咒诅。
28.en: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

28.zh: 你的筐子和你的抟面盆都必受咒诅。
28.en: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

28.zh: 你身所生的，地所产的，以及牛犊、羊羔，都必受咒诅。
28.en: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

28.zh: 你出也受咒诅，入也受咒诅。
28.en: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

28.zh: 耶和华因你行恶离弃他，必在你手里所办的一切事上，使咒诅、扰乱、责罚临到你，直到你被毁灭，速速地灭亡。
28.en: The LORD will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

28.zh: 耶和华必使瘟疫贴在你身上，直到他将你从所进去得为业的地上灭绝。
28.en: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.

28.zh: 耶和华要用痨病、热病、火症、疟疾、刀剑、旱[风]、霉烂攻击你。这都要追赶你，直到你灭亡。
28.en: The LORD will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.

28.zh: 你头上的天要变为铜，脚下的地要变为铁。
28.en: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.

28.zh: 耶和华要使那降在你地上的雨变为尘沙，从天临在你身上，直到你灭亡。
28.en: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.

28.zh: 「耶和华必使你败在仇敌面前，你从一条路去攻击他们，必从七条路逃跑。你必在天下万国中抛来抛去。
28.en: The LORD will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

28.zh: 你的尸首必给空中的飞鸟和地上的走兽作食物，并无人哄赶。
28.en: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.

28.zh: 耶和华必用埃及人的疮并痔疮、牛皮癣与疥攻击你，使你不能医治。
28.en: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

28.zh: 耶和华必用癫狂、眼瞎、心惊攻击你。
28.en: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

28.zh: 你必在午间摸索，好像瞎子在暗中摸索一样。你所行的必不亨通，时常遭遇欺压、抢夺，无人搭救。
28.en: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

28.zh: 你聘定了妻，别人必与她同房；你建造房屋，不得住在其内；你栽种葡萄园，也不得用其中的果子。
28.en: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

28.zh: 你的牛在你眼前宰了，你必不得吃它的肉；你的驴在你眼前被抢夺，不得归还；你的羊归了仇敌，无人搭救。
28.en: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.

28.zh: 你的儿女必归与别国的民；你的眼目终日切望，甚至失明，你手中无力拯救。
28.en: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.

28.zh: 你的土产和你劳碌得来的，必被你所不认识的国民吃尽。你时常被欺负，受压制，
28.en: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,

28.zh: 甚至你因眼中所看见的，必致疯狂。
28.en: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.

28.zh: 耶和华必攻击你，使你膝上腿上，从脚掌到头顶，长毒疮无法医治。
28.en: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

28.zh: 「耶和华必将你和你所立的王领到你和你列祖素不认识的国去；在那里你必事奉木头石头的神。
28.en: The LORD will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

28.zh: 你在耶和华领你到的各国中，要令人惊骇、笑谈、讥诮。
28.en: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away.

28.zh: 你带到田间的种子虽多，收进来的却少，因为被蝗虫吃了。
28.en: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.

28.zh: 你栽种、修理葡萄园，却不得收[葡萄]，也不得喝[葡萄]酒，因为被虫子吃了。
28.en: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.

28.zh: 你全境有橄榄树，却不得其油抹身，因为树上的橄榄不熟自落了。
28.en: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.

28.zh: 你生儿养女，却不算是你的，因为必被掳去。
28.en: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

28.zh: 你所有的树木和你地里的出产必被蝗虫所吃。
28.en: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

28.zh: 在你中间寄居的，必渐渐上升，比你高而又高；你必渐渐下降，低而又低。
28.en: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

28.zh: 他必借给你，你却不能借给他；他必作首，你必作尾。
28.en: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

28.zh: 这一切咒诅必追随你，赶上你，直到你灭亡；因为你不听从耶和华—你　神的话，不遵守他所吩咐的诫命律例。
28.en: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

28.zh: 这些咒诅必在你和你后裔的身上成为异迹奇事，直到永远！
28.en: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.

28.zh: 「因为你富有的时候，不欢心乐意地事奉耶和华—你的　神，
28.en: Because you didn’t serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

28.zh: 所以你必在饥饿、干渴、赤露、缺乏之中事奉耶和华所打发来攻击你的仇敌。他必把铁轭加在你的颈项上，直到将你灭绝。
28.en: therefore you will serve your enemies whom the LORD sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

28.zh: 「耶和华要从远方、地极带一国的民，如鹰飞来攻击你。这民的言语，你不懂得。
28.en: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,

28.zh: 这民的面貌凶恶，不顾恤年老的，也不恩待年少的。
28.en: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.

28.zh: 他们必吃你牲畜所下的和你地土所产的，直到你灭亡。你的五谷、新酒，和油，以及牛犊、羊羔，都不给你留下，直到将你灭绝。
28.en: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.

28.zh: 他们必将你困在你各城里，直到你所倚靠、高大坚固的城墙都被攻塌。他们必将你困在耶和华—你　神所赐你遍地的各城里。
28.en: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you.

28.zh: 你在仇敌围困窘迫之中，必吃你本身所生的，就是耶和华—你　神所赐给你的儿女之肉。
28.en: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.

28.zh: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的人必恶眼看他弟兄和他怀中的妻，并他余剩的儿女；
28.en: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,

28.zh: 甚至在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中，他要吃儿女的肉，不肯分一点给他的亲人，因为他一无所剩。
28.en: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.

28.zh: 你们中间，柔弱娇嫩的妇人，是因娇嫩柔弱不肯把脚踏地的，必恶眼看她怀中的丈夫和她的儿女。
28.en: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,

28.zh: 她两腿中间出来的婴孩与她所要生的儿女，她因缺乏一切就要在你受仇敌围困窘迫的城中将他们暗暗地吃了。
28.en: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.

28.zh: 「这书上所写律法的一切话是叫你敬畏耶和华—你　神可荣可畏的名。你若不谨守遵行，耶和华就必将奇灾，就是至大至长的灾，至重至久的病，加在你和你后裔的身上，
28.en: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD your God,
then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.

28.zh: 也必使你所惧怕、埃及人的病都临到你，贴在你身上，
28.en: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

28.zh: 又必将没有写在这律法书上的各样疾病、灾殃降在你身上，直到你灭亡。
28.en: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

28.zh: 你们先前虽然像天上的星那样多，却因不听从耶和华—你　神的话，所剩的人数就稀少了。
28.en: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

28.zh: 先前耶和华怎样喜悦善待你们，使你们众多，也要照样喜悦毁灭你们，使你们灭亡；并且你们从所要进去得的地上必被拔除。
28.en: It will happen that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

28.zh: 耶和华必使你们分散在万民中，从地这边到地那边，你必在那里事奉你和你列祖素不认识、木头石头的神。
28.en: The LORD will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

28.zh: 在那些国中，你必不得安逸，也不得落脚之地；耶和华却使你在那里心中跳动，眼目失明，精神消耗。
28.en: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but the LORD will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

28.zh: 你的性命必悬悬无定；你昼夜恐惧，自料性命难保。
28.en: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

28.zh: 你因心里所恐惧的，眼中所看见的，早晨必说，巴不得到晚上才好；晚上必说，巴不得到早晨才好。
28.en: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.

28.zh: 耶和华必使你坐船回埃及去，走我曾告诉你不得再见的路；在那里你必卖己身与仇敌作奴婢，却无人买。」
28.en: The LORD will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.

29.zh: 这是耶和华在摩押地吩咐摩西与以色列人立约的话，是在他和他们于何烈山所立的约之外。
29.en: These are the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

29.zh: 摩西召了以色列众人来，对他们说：「耶和华在埃及地，在你们眼前向法老和他众臣仆，并他全地所行的一切事，你们都看见了，
29.en: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;

29.zh: 就是你亲眼看见的大试验和神迹，并那些大奇事。
29.en: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

29.zh: 但耶和华到今日没有使你们心能明白，眼能看见，耳能听见。
29.en: But the LORD has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

29.zh: 我领你们在旷野四十年，你们身上的衣服并没有穿破，脚上的鞋也没有穿坏。
29.en: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.

29.zh: 你们没有吃饼，也没有喝清酒浓酒。这要使你们知道，耶和华是你们的　神。
29.en: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.

29.zh: 你们来到这地方，希实本王西宏、巴珊王噩都出来与我们交战，我们就击杀了他们，
29.en: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

29.zh: 取了他们的地给吕便支派、迦得支派，和玛拿西半支派为业。
29.en: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.

29.zh: 所以你们要谨守遵行这约的话，好叫你们在一切所行的事上亨通。
29.en: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.

29.zh: 「今日，你们的首领、族长、长老、官长、以色列的男丁，你们的妻子儿女，和营中寄居的，以及为你们劈柴挑水的人，都站在耶和华—你们的　神面前，
29.en: All of you stand today in the presence of the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,

29.zh: 为要你顺从耶和华—你　神今日与你所立的约，向你所起的誓。
29.en: that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, and into his oath, which the LORD your God makes with you today,

29.zh: 这样，他要照他向你所应许的话，又向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所起的誓，今日立你作他的子民，他作你的　神。
