29.en: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

29.zh: 我不但与你们立这约，起这誓，
29.en: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

29.zh: 凡与我们一同站在耶和华—我们　神面前的，并今日不在我们这里的人，我也与他们立这约，起这誓。
29.en: but with those who stand here with us today before the LORD our God, and also with those who are not here with us today

29.zh: 「我们曾住过埃及地，也从列国经过；这是你们知道的。
29.en: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;

29.zh: 你们也看见他们中间可憎之物，并他们木、石、金、银的偶像。
29.en: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);

29.zh: 惟恐你们中间，或男或女，或族长或支派长，今日心里偏离耶和华—我们的　神，去事奉那些国的神；又怕你们中间有[恶]根生出苦菜和茵 来，
29.en: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;

29.zh: 听见这咒诅的话，心里仍是自夸说：『我虽然行事心里顽梗，连累众人，却还是平安。』
29.en: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.

29.zh: 耶和华必不饶恕他；耶和华的怒气与愤恨要向他发作，如烟冒出，将这书上所写的一切咒诅都加在他身上。耶和华又要从天下涂抹他的名，
29.en: The LORD will not pardon him, but then the LORD’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and the LORD will blot out his name from under the sky.

29.zh: 也必照着写在律法书上、约中的一切咒诅将他从以色列众支派中分别出来，使他受祸。
29.en: The LORD will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.

29.zh: 你们的后代，就是以后兴起来的子孙，和远方来的外人，看见这地的灾殃，并耶和华所降与这地的疾病，
29.en: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which the LORD has made it sick,

29.zh: 又看见遍地有硫磺，有盐卤，有火迹，没有耕种，没有出产，连草都不生长—好像耶和华在忿怒中所倾覆的所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁一样—
29.en: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.

29.zh: 所看见的人，连万国人，都必问说：『耶和华为何向此地这样行呢？这样大发烈怒是什么意思呢？』
29.en: Even all the nations will say, “Why has the LORD done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”

29.zh: 人必回答说：『是因这地的人离弃了耶和华—他们列祖的　神，领他们出埃及地的时候与他们所立的约，
29.en: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,

29.zh: 去事奉敬拜素不认识的别神，是耶和华所未曾给他们安排的。
29.en: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.

29.zh: 所以耶和华的怒气向这地发作，将这书上所写的一切咒诅都降在这地上。
29.en: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

29.zh: 耶和华在怒气、忿怒、大恼恨中将他们从本地拔出来，扔在别的地上，像今日一样。』
29.en: The LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”

29.zh: 「隐秘的事是属耶和华—我们　神的；惟有明显的事是永远属我们和我们子孙的，好叫我们遵行这律法上的一切话。」
29.en: The secret things belong to the LORD our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.

30.zh: 「我所陈明在你面前的这一切咒诅都临到你身上；你在耶和华—你　神追赶你到的万国中必心里追念祝福的话；
30.en: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,

30.zh: 你和你的子孙若尽心尽性归向耶和华—你的　神，照着我今日一切所吩咐的听从他的话；
30.en: and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

30.zh: 那时，耶和华—你的　神必怜恤你，救回你这被掳的子民；耶和华—你的　神要回转过来，从分散你到的万民中将你招聚回来。
30.en: that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.

30.zh: 你被赶散的人，就是在天涯的，耶和华—你的　神也必从那里将你招聚回来。
30.en: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

30.zh: 耶和华—你的　神必领你进入你列祖所得的地，使你可以得着；又必善待你，使你的人数比你列祖众多。
30.en: The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

30.zh: 耶和华—你　神必将你心里和你后裔心里的污秽除掉，好叫你尽心尽性爱耶和华—你的　神，使你可以存活。
30.en: The LORD your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

30.zh: 耶和华—你的　神必将这一切咒诅加在你仇敌和恨恶你、逼迫你的人身上。
30.en: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

30.zh: 你必归回，听从耶和华的话，遵行他的一切诫命，就是我今日所吩咐你的。
30.en: You shall return and obey the LORD’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

30.zh: 你若听从耶和华—你　神的话，谨守这律法书上所写的诫命律例，又尽心尽性归向耶和华—你的　神，他必使你手里所办的一切事，并你身所生的，牲畜所下的，地土所产的，都绰绰有余；因为耶和华必再喜悦你，降福与你，像从前喜悦你列祖一样。
30.en: The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

if you will obey the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

30.zh: 「我今日所吩咐你的诫命不是你难行的，也不是离你远的；
30.en: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

30.zh: 不是在天上，使你说：『谁替我们上天取下来，使我们听见可以遵行呢？』
30.en: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

30.zh: 也不是在海外，使你说：『谁替我们过海取了来，使我们听见可以遵行呢？』
30.en: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

30.zh: 这话却离你甚近，就在你口中，在你心里，使你可以遵行。
30.en: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

30.zh: 「看哪，我今日将生与福，死与祸，陈明在你面前。
30.en: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

30.zh: 吩咐你爱耶和华—你的　神，遵行他的道，谨守他的诫命、律例、典章，使你可以存活，人数增多，耶和华—你　神就必在你所要进去得为业的地上赐福与你。
30.en: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

30.zh: 倘若你心里偏离，不肯听从，却被勾引去敬拜事奉别神，
30.en: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

30.zh: 我今日明明告诉你们，你们必要灭亡；在你过约旦河、进去得为业的地上，你的日子必不长久。
30.en: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

30.zh: 我今日呼天唤地向你作见证；我将生死祸福陈明在你面前，所以你要拣选生命，使你和你的后裔都得存活；
30.en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

30.zh: 且爱耶和华—你的　神，听从他的话，专靠他；因为他是你的生命，你的日子长久也在乎他。这样，你就可以在耶和华向你列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许所赐的地上居住。」
30.en: to love the LORD your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

31.zh: 摩西去告诉以色列众人
31.en: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

31.zh: 说：「我现在一百二十岁了，不能照常出入；耶和华也曾对我说：『你必不得过这约旦河。』
31.en: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. The LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

31.zh: 耶和华—你们的　神必引导你们过去，将这些国民在你们面前灭绝，你们就得他们的地。约书亚必引导你们过去，正如耶和华所说的。
31.en: The LORD your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as the LORD has spoken.

31.zh: 耶和华必待他们，如同从前待他所灭绝的亚摩利二王西宏与噩以及他们的国一样。
31.en: The LORD will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

31.zh: 耶和华必将他们交给你们；你们要照我所吩咐的一切命令待他们。
31.en: The LORD will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

31.zh: 你们当刚强壮胆，不要害怕，也不要畏惧他们，因为耶和华—你的　神和你同去。他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。」
31.en: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

31.zh: 摩西召了约书亚来，在以色列众人眼前对他说：「你当刚强壮胆！因为，你要和这百姓一同进入耶和华向他们列祖起誓应许所赐之地；你也要使他们承受那地为业。
31.en: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

31.zh: 耶和华必在你前面行；他必与你同在，必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。」
31.en: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

31.zh: 摩西将这律法写出来，交给抬耶和华约柜的祭司利未子孙和以色列的众长老。
31.en: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.

31.zh: 摩西吩咐他们说：「每逢七年的末一年，就在豁免年的定期住棚节的时候，
31.en: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,

31.zh: 以色列众人来到耶和华—你　神所选择的地方朝见他。那时，你要在以色列众人面前将这律法念给他们听。
31.en: when all Israel has come to appear before the LORD your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

31.zh: 要招聚他们男、女、孩子，并城里寄居的，使他们听，使他们学习，好敬畏耶和华—你们的　神，谨守、遵行这律法的一切话，
31.en: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,

31.zh: 也使他们未曾晓得[这律法]的儿女得以听见，学习敬畏耶和华—你们的　神，在你们过约旦河要得为业之地，存活的日子，常常这样行。」
31.en: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

31.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你的死期临近了；要召约书亚来，你们二人站在会幕里，我好嘱咐他。」于是摩西和约书亚去站在会幕里。
31.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.

31.zh: 耶和华在[会]幕里云柱中显现，云柱停在[会]幕门以上。
31.en: The LORD appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.

31.zh: 耶和华又对摩西说：「你必和你列祖同睡。这百姓要起来，在他们所要去的地上，在那地的人中，随从外邦神行邪淫，离弃我，违背我与他们所立的约。
31.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.

31.zh: 那时，我的怒气必向他们发作；我也必离弃他们，掩面不顾他们，以致他们被吞灭，并有许多的祸患灾难临到他们。那日他们必说：『这些祸患临到我们，岂不是因我们的　神不在我们中间吗？』
31.en: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’

31.zh: 那时，因他们偏向别神所行的一切恶，我必定掩面不顾他们。
31.en: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.

31.zh: 现在你要写一篇歌，教导以色列人，传给他们，使这歌见证他们的不是；
31.en: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

31.zh: 因为我将他们领进我向他们列祖起誓应许那流奶与蜜之地，他们在那里吃得饱足，身体肥胖，就必偏向别神，事奉他们，藐视我，背弃我的约。
31.en: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

31.zh: 那时，有许多祸患灾难临到他们，这歌必在他们面前作见证，他们后裔的口中必念诵不忘。我未领他们到我所起誓应许之地以先，他们所怀的意念我都知道了。」
31.en: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”

31.zh: 当日摩西就写了一篇歌，教导以色列人。
31.en: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.

31.zh: 耶和华嘱咐嫩的儿子约书亚说：「你当刚强壮胆，因为你必领以色列人进我所起誓应许他们的地；我必与你同在。」
31.en: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”

31.zh: 摩西将这律法的话写在书上，及至写完了，
31.en: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

31.zh: 就吩咐抬耶和华约柜的利未人说：
31.en: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, saying,

31.zh: 「将这律法书放在耶和华—你们　神的约柜旁，可以在那里见证以色列人的不是；
31.en: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.

31.zh: 因为我知道你们是悖逆的，是硬着颈项的。我今日还活着与你们同在，你们尚且悖逆耶和华，何况我死后呢？
31.en: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD. How much more after my death?

31.zh: 你们要将你们支派的众长老和官长都招聚了来，我好将这些话说与他们听，并呼天唤地见证他们的不是。
31.en: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

31.zh: 我知道我死后，你们必全然败坏，偏离我所吩咐你们的道，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，以手所做的惹他发怒；日后必有祸患临到你们。」
31.en: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”

31.zh: 摩西将这一篇歌的话都说与以色列全会众听。
31.en: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.

32.zh: 诸天哪，侧耳，我要说话； 愿地也听我口中的言语。
32.en: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

32.zh: 我的教训要淋漓如雨； 我的言语要滴落如露， 如细雨降在嫩草上， 如甘霖降在菜蔬中。
32.en: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.

32.zh: 我要宣告耶和华的名； 你们要将大德归与我们的　神。
32.en: For I will proclaim the LORD’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!

32.zh: 他是磐石，他的作为完全； 他所行的无不公平， 是诚实无伪的　神， 又公义，又正直。
32.en: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.

32.zh: 这乖僻弯曲的世代向他行事邪僻； 有这弊病就不是他的儿女。
32.en: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.

32.zh: 愚昧无知的民哪，你们这样报答耶和华吗？ 他岂不是你的父、将你买来的吗？ 他是制造你、建立你的。
32.en: Is this the way you repay the LORD, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.

32.zh: 你当追想上古之日， 思念历代之年； 问你的父亲，他必指示你； 问你的长者，他必告诉你。
32.en: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

32.zh: 至高者将地业赐给列邦，将世人分开， 就照以色列人的数目立定万民的疆界。
32.en: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

32.zh: 耶和华的分本是他的百姓； 他的产业本是雅各。
32.en: For the LORD’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

32.zh: 耶和华遇见他在旷野— 荒凉野兽吼叫之地， 就环绕他，看顾他， 保护他，如同保护眼中的瞳人。
32.en: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.

32.zh: 又如鹰搅动巢窝， 在雏鹰以上两翅搧展， 接取雏鹰，背在两翼之上。
32.en: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.

32.zh: 这样，耶和华独自引导他， 并无外邦神与他同在。
32.en: The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.

32.zh: 耶和华使他乘驾地的高处， 得吃田间的土产； 又使他从磐石中咂蜜， 从坚石中吸油；
32.en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;

32.zh: 也吃牛的奶油， 羊的奶，羊羔的脂油， 巴珊所出的公绵羊和山羊， 与上好的麦子， 也喝葡萄汁酿的酒。
32.en: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.

32.zh: 但耶书 渐渐肥胖，粗壮， 光润，踢跳，[奔跑]， 便离弃造他的　神， 轻看救他的磐石；
32.en: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.

32.zh: 敬拜别[神]，触动　神的愤恨， 行可憎恶的事，惹了他的怒气。
32.en: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.

32.zh: 所祭祀的鬼魔并非真神， 乃是素不认识的神， 是近来新兴的， 是你列祖所不畏惧的。
32.en: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.

32.zh: 你轻忽生你的磐石， 忘记产你的　神。
32.en: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.

32.zh: 耶和华看见他的儿女惹动他， 就厌恶[他们]，说：
32.en: The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

32.zh: 我要向他们掩面， 看他们的结局如何。 他们本是极乖僻的族类， 心中无诚实的儿女。
32.en: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

32.zh: 他们以那「不算为神」的触动我的愤恨， 以虚无[的神]惹了我的怒气。 我也要以那「不成子民」的触动他们的愤恨， 以愚昧的国民惹了他们的怒气。
32.en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

32.zh: 因为在我怒中有火烧起， 直烧到极深的阴间， 把地和地的出产尽都焚烧， 山的根基也烧着了。
32.en: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.

32.zh: 我要将祸患堆在他们身上， 把我的箭向他们射尽。
32.en: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.

32.zh: [他们必]因饥饿消瘦， 被炎热苦毒吞灭。 我要打发野兽用牙齿咬他们， 并土中腹行的，用毒气害他们。
32.en: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

32.zh: 外头有刀剑，内室有惊恐， 使人丧亡，使少男、童女、 吃奶的、白发的，[尽都灭绝]。
32.en: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.

32.zh: 我说，我必将他们分散远方， 使他们的名号从人间除灭。
32.en: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;

32.zh: 惟恐仇敌惹动我， 只怕敌人错看，说：是我们手的能力， 并非耶和华所行的。
32.en: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; the LORD has not done all this.’”

32.zh: 因为以色列民毫无计谋， 心中没有聪明。
32.en: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.

32.zh: 惟愿他们有智慧， 能明白这事，肯思念他们的结局。
32.en: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

32.zh: 若不是他们的磐石卖了他们， 若不是耶和华交出他们， 一人焉能追赶他们千人？ 二人焉能使万人逃跑呢？
32.en: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had delivered them up?

32.zh: 据我们的仇敌自己断定， 他们的磐石不如我们的磐石。
32.en: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.

32.zh: 他们的葡萄树是所多玛的葡萄树， 蛾摩拉田园所生的； 他们的葡萄是毒葡萄， 全挂都是苦的。
32.en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.

32.zh: 他们的酒是大蛇的毒气， 是虺蛇残害的恶毒。
32.en: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.

32.zh: 这不都是积蓄在我这里， 封锁在我府库中吗？
32.en: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?

32.zh: 他们失脚的时候，伸冤报应在我； 因他们遭灾的日子近了； 那要临在他们身上的必速速来到。
32.en: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”

32.zh: 耶和华见他百姓毫无能力， 无论困住的、自由的都没有[剩下]， 就必为他们伸冤， 为他的仆人后悔。
32.en: For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.

32.zh: 他必说：他们的神， 他们所投靠的磐石，
32.en: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

32.zh: 就是向来吃他们祭牲的脂油， 喝他们奠祭之酒的，在哪里呢？ 他可以兴起帮助你们， 护卫你们。
32.en: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

32.zh: 你们如今要知道： 我，惟有我是　神； 在我以外并无别神。 我使人死，我使人活； 我损伤，我也医治， 并无人能从我手中救出来。
32.en: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.

32.zh: 我向天举手说： 我凭我的永生起誓：
32.en: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,

32.zh: 我若磨我闪亮的刀， 手掌审判之权， 就必报复我的敌人， 报应恨我的人。
32.en: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.

32.zh: 我要使我的箭饮血饮醉， 就是被杀被掳之人的血。 我的刀要吃肉， 乃是仇敌中首领之头的肉。
32.en: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”

32.zh: 你们外邦人当与主的百姓一同欢呼； 因他要伸他仆人流血的冤， 报应他的敌人， 洁净他的地，救赎他的百姓。
32.en: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.

32.zh: 摩西和嫩的儿子约书亚去将这歌的一切话说给百姓听。
32.en: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

32.zh: 摩西向以色列众人说完了这一切的话，
32.en: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.

32.zh: 又说：「我今日所警教你们的，你们都要放在心上；要吩咐你们的子孙谨守遵行这律法上的话。
32.en: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

32.zh: 因为这不是虚空、与你们无关的事，乃是你们的生命；在你们过约旦河要得为业的地上必因这事日子得以长久。」
32.en: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

32.zh: 当日，耶和华吩咐摩西说：
32.en: The LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

32.zh: 「你上这亚巴琳山中的尼波山去，在摩押地与耶利哥相对，观看我所要赐给以色列人为业的迦南地。
32.en: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.

32.zh: 你必死在你所登的山上，归你列祖去，像你哥哥亚伦死在何珥山上，归他的列祖一样。
32.en: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

32.zh: 因为你们在寻的旷野，加低斯的米利巴水，在以色列人中没有尊我为圣，得罪了我。
32.en: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.

32.zh: 我所赐给以色列人的地，你可以远远地观看，却不得进去。」
32.en: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”

33.zh: 以下是神人摩西在未死之先为以色列人所祝的福：
33.en: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

33.zh: 他说：耶和华从西奈而来， 从西珥向他们显现， 从巴兰山发出光辉， 从万万圣者中来临， 从他右手为百姓传出烈火的律法。
33.en: He said, “The LORD came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.

33.zh: 他疼爱百姓； 众圣徒都在他手中。 他们坐在他的脚下， 领受他的言语。
33.en: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.

33.zh: 摩西将律法传给我们， 作为雅各会众的产业。
33.en: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.

33.zh: 百姓的众首领， 以色列的各支派， 一同聚会的时候， 耶和华在耶书 中为王。
33.en: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.

33.zh: 愿吕便存活，不致死亡； 愿他人数不致稀少。
33.en: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”

33.zh: 为犹大祝福说： 求耶和华俯听犹大的声音， 引导他归于本族； 他曾用手为自己争战， 你必帮助他攻击敌人。
33.en: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”

33.zh: 论利未说： [耶和华啊]，你的土明和乌陵 都在你的虔诚人那里。 你在玛撒曾试验他， 在米利巴水与他争论。
33.en: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.

33.zh: 他论自己的父母说： 我未曾看见； 他也不承认弟兄， 也不认识自己的儿女。 这是因利未人遵行你的话， 谨守你的约。
33.en: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.

33.zh: 他们要将你的典章教训雅各， 将你的律法教训以色列。 他们要把香焚在你面前， 把全牲的燔祭献在你的坛上。
33.en: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.

33.zh: 求耶和华降福在他的财物上， 悦纳他手里所办的事。 那些起来攻击他和恨恶他的人， 愿你刺透他们的腰， 使他们不得再起来。
33.en: LORD, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”

33.zh: 论便雅悯说： 耶和华所亲爱的必同耶和华安然居住； 耶和华终日遮蔽他，也住在他两肩之中。
33.en: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of the LORD will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”

33.zh: 论约瑟说： 愿他的地蒙耶和华赐福， 得天上的宝物、甘露， 以及地里所藏的泉水；
33.en: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by the LORD, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,

33.zh: 得太阳所晒熟的美果， 月亮所养成的宝物；
33.en: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,

33.zh: 得上古之山的至宝， 永世之岭的宝物；
33.en: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,

33.zh: 得地和其中所充满的宝物， 并住荆棘中上主的喜悦。 愿[这些福]都归于约瑟的头上， 归于那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。
33.en: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

33.zh: 他为牛群中头生的，有威严； 他的角是野牛的角， 用以抵触万邦，直到地极。 这角是以法莲的万万， 玛拿西的千千。
33.en: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”

33.zh: 论西布伦说： 西布伦哪，你出外可以欢喜。 以萨迦啊，在你帐棚里可以快乐。
33.en: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.

33.zh: 他们要将列邦召到山上， 在那里献公义的祭； 因为他们要吸取海里的丰富， 并沙中所藏的珍宝。
33.en: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”

33.zh: 论迦得说： 使迦得扩张的应当称颂！ 迦得住如母狮； 他撕裂膀臂，连头顶也撕裂。
33.en: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.

33.zh: 他为自己选择头一段地， 因在那里有设立律法者的分存留。 他与百姓的首领同来； 他施行耶和华的公义 和耶和华与以色列所立的典章。
33.en: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of the LORD, His ordinances with Israel.”

33.zh: 论但说： 但为小狮子， 从巴珊跳出来。
33.en: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”

33.zh: 论拿弗他利说： 拿弗他利啊，你足沾恩惠， 满得耶和华的福， 可以得西方和南方为业。
33.en: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of the LORD’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”

33.zh: 论亚设说： 愿亚设享受多子的福乐， 得他弟兄的喜悦， 可以把脚蘸在油中。
33.en: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.

33.zh: 你的门闩是铜的，铁的。 你的日子如何，你的力量也必如何。
33.en: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.

33.zh: 耶书 哪，没有能比　神的。 他为帮助你，乘在天空， 显其威荣，驾行穹苍。
33.en: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.

33.zh: 永生的　神是[你的]居所； 他永久的膀臂在你以下。 他在你前面撵出仇敌， 说：毁灭吧。
33.en: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

33.zh: 以色列安然居住； 雅各的本源独居五谷新酒之地。 他的天也滴甘露。
33.en: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.

33.zh: 以色列啊，你是有福的！ 谁像你这蒙耶和华所拯救的百姓呢？ 他是你的盾牌，帮助你， 是你威荣的刀剑。 你的仇敌必投降你； 你必踏在他们的高处。
33.en: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”

34.zh: 摩西从摩押平原登尼波山，上了那与耶利哥相对的毗斯迦山顶。耶和华把基列全地直到但，
34.en: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. The LORD showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,

34.zh: 拿弗他利全地，以法莲、玛拿西的地，犹大全地直到西海，
34.en: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,

34.zh: 南地和棕树城耶利哥的平原，直到琐珥，都指给他看。
34.en: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

34.zh: 耶和华对他说：「这就是我向亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各起誓应许之地，说：『我必将这地赐给你的后裔。』现在我使你眼睛看见了，你却不得过到那里去。」
34.en: The LORD said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”

34.zh: 于是，耶和华的仆人摩西死在摩押地，正如耶和华所说的。
34.en: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the LORD’s word.

34.zh: 耶和华将他埋葬在摩押地、伯·毗珥对面的谷中，只是到今日没有人知道他的坟墓。
34.en: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

34.zh: 摩西死的时候年一百二十岁；眼目没有昏花，精神没有衰败。
34.en: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

34.zh: 以色列人在摩押平原为摩西哀哭了三十日，为摩西居丧哀哭的日子就满了。
34.en: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.

34.zh: 嫩的儿子约书亚；因为摩西曾按手在他[头]上，就被智慧的灵充满，以色列人便听从他，照着耶和华吩咐摩西的行了。
34.en: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

34.zh: 以后以色列中再没有兴起先知像摩西的。他是耶和华面对面所认识的。
34.en: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

34.zh: 耶和华打发他在埃及地向法老和他的一切臣仆，并他的全地，行各样神迹奇事，
34.en: in all the signs and the wonders which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

34.zh: 又在以色列众人眼前显大能的手，行一切大而可畏的事。
34.en: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
